member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfBlockTableRecord.AddLinearParameter(System.String,System.String,GeometryHelper.Geometry.GeoPoint3,GeometryHelper.Geometry.GeoPoint3,System.Double,GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfBlockParameterValueSet)
member.summary: Makes the block dynamic, where it is not, and gives it a linear parameter: a distance from a base point to an end point that each INSERT of the block shows as the dynamic property of its name, AutoCAD's Linear parameter of two grips as its Block Editor makes one. Tie the parameter to the entities it moves with , and .
member.param: The label of the parameter, the name of the property, as Width.
The description of the property; null or empty for none.
The point the distance is measured from, in the block's coordinates.
The point the distance is measured to, which the property moves.
How far the label stands off the line, to its left looking from the base point to the end point: -20 puts the label of a Width along x 20 below it.
The values the distance may take (, ); null for any.
member.returns: The parameter, as written.

remarks.para: A rectangle 100 by 50 from the origin given AddLinearParameter("Width", "Overall width", new GeoPoint3(0, 0, 0), new GeoPoint3(100, 0, 0), -20, DxfBlockParameterValueSet.Increments(50, 300, 10)) and a stretch of its right edge is the block AutoCAD 2021 read as dynamic (plugin v17): every INSERT of it shows Width 100, and a Width set to 200 moves the right edge to x = 200; 75 goes to 70, 77 to 80 and 400 to 300 by the value set.

The first parameter makes the block dynamic, as AutoCAD's Block Editor saves it: its BLOCK_RECORD is given the extended data AcDbDynamicBlockTrueName (its name), AcDbDynamicBlockGUID (a new GUID) and AcDbBlockRepETag, each of its entities a tag of AcDbBlockRepETag, and its extension dictionary the evaluation graph (ACAD_ENHANCEDBLOCK) and the purge preventer; the classes of the objects are listed in the CLASSES section. Each parameter is written as AutoCAD writes one, with its end grip and base grip, each with its two location components: seven nodes of the graph and six edges. Its element is named Linear, the next Linear1 and on, as AutoCAD names them. The block may be given several, each a property of its INSERTs in the order they were added.

An INSERT of the block shows the block's own distance until its property is set, by AutoCAD or by , which works the block out into an anonymous copy the INSERT places; reads either. An entity appended after the last parameter or action has no tag, which AutoCAD 2021 did not need (plugin v17, 24a-c).

member.exception: Thrown when the name or a point is null.

Thrown when the name is empty, the name or the description holds a line break, the base point and the end point are within the point tolerance of , or the value set does not hold the distance between them, the block's own value.
Thrown when the offset is not a finite number.

Thrown when the block is in no file, is erased, is model space, paper space or the block of a layout, is anonymous or of an external reference, or its drawing is older than R2010 (AC1024), the oldest AutoCAD was seen to read such a block of.
Thrown when the block has a flip parameter, which is written alone in its block (). Nothing is written then.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfBlockTableRecord.AddStretchAction(GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfBlockLinearParameter,GeometryHelper.Geometry.GeoPoint2,GeometryHelper.Geometry.GeoPoint2,System.Collections.Generic.IEnumerable{GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfEntity})
member.summary: Gives the block a stretch action tied to a linear parameter of it, AutoCAD's Stretch action as its Block Editor makes one: as the parameter's distance grows by an amount, the points of the entities inside the frame move by that amount along the line from the parameter's base point to its end point and the points outside stay, so an entity across the frame stretches and one inside it moves whole.
member.param: The parameter of this block the action follows, by its end point.
A corner of the stretch frame, a rectangle along the block's x and y.
The entities of the block to stretch, each with one point in the frame at least: a LINE's () start or end, a LWPOLYLINE's () vertex, or the one point of the other kinds the remarks list.

remarks.para: The rectangle 100 by 50 of the lines (100, 0)-(100, 50), (0, 0)-(100, 0), (0, 50)-(100, 50) and (0, 50)-(0, 0), its Width from (0, 0, 0) to (100, 0, 0), given the frame from (90, -10) to (110, 60) and the first three lines, holds the right edge whole and the right ends of the bottom and the top: AutoCAD 2021 set Width to 200 and moved them to x = 200, the left edge staying at x = 0 (plugin v17). A point is in the frame within the point tolerance of , on its border among them. The action is written as AutoCAD writes one: its frame as two corners, the least first, each entity with the indices of its points in the frame (0 a line's start, 1 its end, a polyline's vertex by its index), and the edge from the parameter in the evaluation graph; its element is named Stretch, the next Stretch1 and on. A parameter may be followed by several actions.

A polyline's vertices are taken in the block's coordinates (), their x and y. An entity of one point moves whole where its point is in the frame, as AutoCAD's STRETCH moves it: a circle () by its centre, a text () by the point it is held by (its position where it stands left on its baseline, else its alignment point), a multiline text () by its location, an INSERT () by its insertion point; each is written as its point 0, as AutoCAD's files write the one point of a text. An arc () is numbered by its ends, 0 its start and 1 its end as AutoCAD numbers them (plugin v20, 24d-k): with both in the frame it moves whole; with one, that end moves and the other stays, the arc keeping the height of its middle off its chord, as AutoCAD 2021 kept 2.929 for the arc of the radius 10 from (100, 25) to (90, 35) whose start went to (150, 25) and then to (200, 25), its radius becoming 159.37 and then 522.13. An arc held by one end lies flat in the block, its normal along z. A text aligned or fitted between two points and an INSERT of rows and columns are refused. An attribute definition () locked in the block () is held by its point as a text is, and each INSERT's ATTRIB of its tag moves with it: MARK at (100, 10) stands at (150, 10) when Width is set from 100 to 150, as AutoCAD 2021 moved it (check D30); AutoCAD moved one not locked in the block but left its ATTRIB, and such a one is refused, as AutoCAD's Block Editor refuses it. An entity given twice is taken once.

member.exception: Thrown when the parameter, a corner, the entities or one of them is null.

Thrown when the parameter is of another block or no longer in its graph, the frame is no wider or no higher than the point tolerance, there are no entities, or an entity is not of this block, is erased, is of a kind not taken, is an attribute definition not locked in the block, has no point in the frame, or is an arc with one end only in it whose normal is not along z. Nothing is written then.
Thrown when the block cannot be dynamic, as says.

Thrown when the block has a flip action, or an entity is also copied by an array action or turned by a polar stretch, or turned or scaled by a rotate or a scale action: AutoCAD 2021 worked a flip with a stretch out from each INSERT's last state and did not flip an INSERT of such a block itself (plugins v20 and v20b), and stretched a line it turned or scaled from where its last set left it (plugin v21, 24e-g). Nothing is written then.

member.summary: Gives the block a stretch action tied to a linear parameter of it, as does, of a distance multiplier and an angle offset, AutoCAD's Distance Multiplier and Angle Offset of the action: the points in the frame move by the change of the parameter's end point times the multiplier, turned by the offset.

member.summary: Makes the block dynamic, where it is not, and gives it a visibility parameter: named states, each showing some of the block's entities and hiding the others the states name, which each INSERT of the block shows as the dynamic property of the parameter's name, AutoCAD's Visibility parameter as its Block Editor makes one. Each INSERT shows the first state until its property is set ().
member.param: The label of the parameter, the name of the property, as Mark.
The description of the property; null or empty for none.
Where the parameter's grip stands, in the block's coordinates.
The states, the first the one the block is kept in; each a name and the entities of this block shown in it ().

remarks.para: A sign of a frame, a cross and a tick given AddVisibilityParameter("Mark", "What the sign shows", new GeoPoint3(20, -10, 0), ...) with the states Cross (the cross), Tick (the tick) and Blank (nothing) gives every INSERT the property Mark of the value Cross, allowed Cross, Tick and Blank. The entities a state names are those the parameter governs: each is shown in the states that name it and hidden in the others; an entity named in no state, the frame, is not governed and is shown in every state. The block itself is kept in its first state, as AutoCAD keeps it: each governed entity not named in the first state is made invisible ( false), the tick here.

The parameter is written as AutoCAD writes one, as AutoCAD 2021 saved the visibility parameter of ACadSharp's sample: the parameter (its element named Visibility State) at the location, with the governed entities and each state with the entities shown in it, its grip and the grip's two location components, four nodes of the evaluation graph and three edges, the classes listed; the block is made dynamic as makes it. Linear parameters and their stretches may come before or after it.

Every state lists the block's other parameters, their grips and its actions, those added before the visibility parameter and those added after it, as AutoCAD's Block Editor lists them in each state of its Door sample: so a Width of the sign is shown, with its grip, in Cross, Tick and Blank alike. AutoCAD 2021 read a state listing none as hiding them, Width not visible in any state and its grip not shown (plugin GhDb1).

member.exception: Thrown when the name, the states or one of them is null.

Thrown when the name is empty, the name or the description holds a line break, a coordinate of the location is not a finite number, there are no states, two states have one name (letters of either case the same), or an entity of a state is not of this block or is erased. Nothing is written then.
Thrown when the block has a visibility parameter already, as AutoCAD's Block Editor gives a block one, or cannot be dynamic, as says.
Thrown when the block has a flip parameter, as says. Nothing is written then.

A corner of the stretch frame, a rectangle along the block's x and y.

remarks.para: The pointer from (0, 0) to (100, 0) of a Length and an Angle from (0, 0, 0) to (100, 0, 0), given the frame from (90, -10) to (110, 10), the line, the circle of the radius 5 at its tip and a polyline from (50, -5) to (100, -5), and a tick from (20, 0) to (20, 10) to turn only, is drawn as AutoCAD 2021 drew it (plugin D25) when Length is set to 150 and Angle to a quarter turn: the line's start stays at the base point and its end goes to (0, 150), the circle with it, the polyline's end held in the frame turns and moves to (5, 150) while its start, outside it, turns alone to (5, 50), and the tick turns alone to (0, 20)-(-10, 20). A circle, a text, a multiline text or an INSERT held by its point, and an arc held by both ends, turn and move whole, a text turned with the line. AutoCAD 2021 worked each set out from the block's own values, not from the last set, and an INSERT scaled by 2 in its own units. A point is in the frame within the point tolerance of , on its border among them.

An attribute definition locked in its block () is taken to stretch or to turn only, and each INSERT's ATTRIB of it turns and moves with it, as AutoCAD 2021 worked them out (check D34): a left one at (100, 10) in the frame above goes, at a Distance of 150 and an Angle of 30 degrees, to (124.904, 83.660), turned by 30 degrees, and one centred on (100, -10) to turn only to (91.603, 41.340).

The action is written as AutoCAD saved the polar stretch of ACadSharp's sample and of AutoCAD's own Annotation sample: the entities it stretches (330), its six connections of the parameter's end point, its frame of two corners (73, 1011 and 1021), the entities it turns only (72, 331), each entity it stretches with the indices of its points in the frame (74, 332, 75 and 76, numbered as a stretch numbers them), the distance multiplier 1 (141) and the angle offset nought (140); its element named Polar Stretch, the next Polar Stretch1 and on; the edge from the parameter, of six connections. An entity to turn only is not among the 330s: named there too, AutoCAD 2021 turned the tick and moved it by the change of the distance besides, to (70, 0)-(70, 10) for a Length of 150. An entity given twice is taken once. The INSERT's cache keeps the record of the parameter (its base point, its end point, the normal down and the base point 10 along x, as AutoCAD keeps it) and of the action (its angle offset), as AutoCAD 2021 wrote them.

member.exception: Thrown when the parameter, a corner, the entities, the entities to turn only or one of them is null.

member.summary: Makes the block dynamic, where it is not, and gives it a lookup parameter with its lookup action: a table of rows, each a label and the values it gives other parameters' properties, which each INSERT of the block shows as the dynamic property of the parameter's name, AutoCAD's Lookup parameter and Lookup action as its Block Editor makes them. Set to a row's label, the property sets the other properties to the row's values; any of those set, it shows the label of the row of their values, or Custom where no row holds them.
member.param: The label of the parameter, the name of the property, as Size.
The description of the property; null or empty for none.
Where the parameter's grip stands, in the block's coordinates.
The input columns of the table, each the property of another parameter of this block (, , , , , , , ), each once.
The rows, each a label and a value for each input column (), the labels apart, letters of either case the same.

remarks.para: A panel of a Width and a Height given AddLookupParameter("Size", "Panel size", new GeoPoint3(50, -20, 0), new[] { DxfBlockLookupInput.Distance(width), DxfBlockLookupInput.Distance(height) }, new[] { new DxfBlockLookupRow("Small", 100, 50), new DxfBlockLookupRow("Large", 200, 80) }) gives every INSERT the property Size, allowed Small and Large; set to Large, Width goes to 200 and Height to 80, stretching what they stretch; Width set to 150 afterwards, Size reads Custom. The lookup property is set and read as AutoCAD keeps it: by its label, a string, letters of either case the same.

The parameter and the action are written as AutoCAD saved those of ACadSharp's lookup sample: the parameter (its element named Lookup, the next Lookup1 and on) with its grip and the grip's two location components; the action (named after it, Lookup1 for the first) with the table row by row, each input column of its parameter's node, of reals, labelled Custom where no row matches, and the lookup column of the parameter, of text, looking back (reverse lookup on), so that the property may be set; five nodes of the evaluation graph and three edges, and a pair of edges each way between the action and each parameter it reads or sets, as AutoCAD pairs them, each of the flags 4 (93) as the sample's: AutoCAD 2021 read a block whose pairs were of the flags nought as dynamic, and none of its INSERTs (plugin v21, 24e-e). An INSERT keeps the label it shows in its cache, as AutoCAD keeps it; one of the block itself, of no cache, shows the label of the first row of the block's own values, Small for its Width 100 and Height 50, else Custom, as AutoCAD 2021 read it (plugin v21b) and as reads it.

A column of an XY parameter's distance along x or along y is written of the connection UpdatedDistanceX or UpdatedDistanceY, of a polar parameter's distance UpdatedDistance, and of a polar or a rotation parameter's angle UpdatedAngle, of the units 1 (96) where a distance's are 2, its values in radians. AutoCAD 2021 read and set them as the library does (plugin D25b): a needle's Way of the rows East 0, North a quarter turn and West pi, set to North, turned it a quarter turn, and its Angle set to pi read West, to 1 Custom. An angle is taken into a turn and matched within the vector tolerance, not round the circle: a row of 2 pi sets nought and reads Custom, and one of -pi / 2 sets 3 pi / 2 and reads the row of 3 pi / 2, as AutoCAD 2021 read them.

member.exception: Thrown when the name, the inputs, the rows or one of them is null.

member.summary: Makes the block dynamic, where it is not, and gives it a block properties table: rows of values, each setting several properties of the block's parameters and attributes at once, which each INSERT of the block shows as the dynamic property Block Table1, the index of its row, AutoCAD's Block Properties Table as its Block Editor makes one. Set to a row's index, the property sets each column to the row's value; it reads the index of the first row of the values the INSERT shows, else -1.
member.param: Where the table's grip stands, in the block's coordinates.
The columns of the table, each the property of a parameter of this block ( and the others), its visibility state () or an attribute definition of it (), each once.

The rows, each a value for each column (): a number for a parameter's column, the name of a state for the visibility's, a text or null, an empty cell, for an attribute definition's; no two rows the same.

remarks.para: A plate of a Width and a Height and the attribute MARK given AddBlockPropertiesTable(new GeoPoint3(0, -20, 0), new[] { DxfBlockPropertiesTableColumn.Distance(width), DxfBlockPropertiesTableColumn.Distance(height), DxfBlockPropertiesTableColumn.Attribute(mark) }, new[] { new DxfBlockPropertiesTableRow(100.0, 50.0, "P100"), new DxfBlockPropertiesTableRow(200.0, 80.0, "P200") }) gives every INSERT the property Block Table1, a ; set to 1, Width goes to 200 and Height to 80, stretching what they stretch, and the INSERT's attribute MARK reads P200. Width set to 150 afterwards, Block Table1 reads -1.

The table is written as AutoCAD 2021 keeps one (plugin D26, AutoCAD's Parking sample and a column added through its BlockPropertiesTable): its element named Block Table and its property Block Table1, its grip and the grip's two location components, four nodes of the evaluation graph; the edge of the grip to the table and of the table to each component; a pair of edges each way between the table and each parameter of a column, of the flags 4, the table first; the graph's extended data AcadBPTGraphNodeId naming the table. Each column names its parameter's node, or the attribute definition, of no connection; each cell is a real, a text, of the type 40 and 1 as AutoCAD writes them. The rows need not match, and no column is constant. An empty cell, of an attribute definition's column only, is written of the type -9999 as AutoCAD writes one; set to its row, the INSERT's attribute reads an empty text, as AutoCAD 2021 gave MARK, and its audit of the table found no fault, where it refused one of an empty cell of a parameter's column (eNotApplicable) and took the property Block Table1 away once a row was set (plugin D26b). A column of the visibility state is written as AutoCAD 2021's AddItem wrote one, its cells texts; a column of an angle is flagged so (293 of 1), as AutoCAD wrote the one it added of a rotation parameter (plugin D26b).

member.exception: Thrown when the columns, the rows or one of them is null.

Thrown when a coordinate of the location is not a finite number, there are no columns or no rows, a column is of another block or given twice, an attribute definition is erased or constant, a row has not one value for each column or a value not of its column's kind (an empty cell outside an attribute definition's column, a text naming no state of the visibility parameter among them), a distance is not above the point tolerance of or not of its parameter's value set, an angle is not of its parameter's value set, or two rows are the same. member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfBlockTableRecord.AppendEntity(GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfEntity)
member.summary: Appends an entity made in code to the block, as AutoCAD's AppendEntity: written at the end of the ENTITIES section for model space and paper space, before the block's ENDBLK for a block, in the file's own style. The same object is the entity of the block from then on, with its handle and its owner.
member.param: The entity, made in code and in no file yet.

remarks.para: Its handle is the next above every handle of the file and above $HANDSEED less one, $HANDSEED set above it, and its owner the block's BLOCK_RECORD from R13 on; an entity of paper space, or of the block of another layout of it (*Paper_Space0 and on), is written with its group 67 of 1, as AutoCAD and ezdxf write it. A file whose records have no handles, as many writers leave them, gives it none. Its layer is added to the layer table where the table does not list it, and the applications of its extended data to the table of applications. The extents of the header grow to hold an entity of model or paper space.

A file of R12 has no SPLINE, ELLIPSE, RAY, XLINE nor LWPOLYLINE, which are refused, nor lineweights or true colours. Nor has it MTEXT: an MTEXT is written there as one TEXT for each paragraph (\P, a column break \N taken as one), its formatting and the heights of its codes left out, not wrapped at its width, which AutoCAD's SAVEAS to R12 wraps by the letters of the font, which the library does not read; and so is each MTEXT of a block copied there with an entity of another drawing, a dimension's *D among them. Each TEXT is in the MTEXT's text style where the drawing has it or is given it by name with the copy, else in Standard; a line of more than 255 letters is written whole, not split, a length older readers of R12 may not take. The TEXTs are appended in the MTEXT's place, and the MTEXT stays in no file: an MTEXT of two lines, 2.5 high and held at its top left at (10, 20), comes out as two TEXTs on the baselines 17.5 and 13.33 high. An entity of R13 or later is written in it in the forms of R12, as AutoCAD saves a drawing as R12: each record keeps the groups R12 has for its type, each read from the part of the record it belongs to (a centred ATTRIB's 72 from its AcDbText, not the 72 its AcDbAttribute writes again), its markers, owner and an object embedded after a group 101 left out; a type with no form of R12 the library writes, as a HATCH, is refused. An entity of R12 in a file of R13 or later is given AutoCAD's subclass markers in their order.

An entity copied from another drawing (, ) has its pointers taken to this drawing as AutoCAD's deep clone between databases takes them: a material, plot style or visual style to the one of the same dictionary and entry names, a record of a table to the one of its name; a pointer to an object this drawing has no namesake of is left out, so that its default holds, but the IMAGEDEF of an IMAGE, which comes with it under its name in the dictionary of images (ACAD_IMAGE_DICT, made where this drawing has none), one IMAGEDEF brought for all the images that show it, as AutoCAD 2021's WblockCloneObjects brings it, with the CLASS rows of IMAGE and IMAGEDEF, or of WIPEOUT, where the drawing lists none, each counted 1, and a row of them counted 0 counted 1, without which AutoCAD 2021 ignores them; an IMAGE that gave an IMAGEDEF of this drawing shows that one, given an IMAGEDEF_REACTOR of its own, nothing brought for it; and a handle of extended data (1005) is left out, as AutoCAD's mapping leaves it null, but for the records the overrides of a dimension style name (ACAD DSTYLE), which name those of the same name here. The records of the tables a copy names that this drawing has not (its layers, linetypes, text styles and dimension styles, and their arrow blocks) are copied with it by name, and a block AutoCAD names itself it draws by (a dimension's *D, an INSERT's *U) under a name of its own, as AutoCAD's deep clone does: one no INSERT, dimension or table of this drawing gives of a block it has not, so that a DIMENSION here naming a *D1 the drawing has not does not come to draw by the copy, which comes as *D2; an INSERT's named block where this drawing has none of its name, under that name, with the blocks it inserts, as AutoCAD's WblockCloneObjects brings it, and every block a copy points to by a hard pointer so too (a MULTILEADER's block and arrow blocks, the block of an ACAD_TABLE's cell), as AutoCAD's deep clone follows its pointers to them. What the entities of the blocks copied point to among themselves (a LEADER to its MTEXT, a HATCH to its boundary) is kept between their copies, whichever comes first in its block, as AutoCAD's deep clone translates its map of ids once every object is copied, and so is every pointer to a block copied with it after its own (a MULTILEADER's block and arrow blocks, an ACAD_TABLE's picture and the blocks of its cells, the arrow block an override of a dimension style names). A copy appended to its own drawing keeps its pointers, but for the value a MULTILEADER gives an attribute definition erased since, which is left out with the definition's handle. A copy of an annotative entity appended is given the contexts it carries, and its ATTRIBs theirs, each under an extension dictionary as AutoCAD writes its copy's (check D35c). Appended to another drawing, each context is put on the scale of its scale's name there, as AutoCAD 2021's WblockCloneObjects and Insert put it: one of the same units taken as it is, one the drawing's list has not added to it, and one of the name of other units added as the name and _1 (or _2 and on, the first the list has not): a context of S7 of 1:3 copied into a drawing whose S7 is 1:7 stands on an S7_1 of 1:3 added for it (check D35d). A drawing that holds no list of scales, older than R2007, takes the copy without them, given the placing it is read at. The extents of the header are not grown by what is appended to a block.

A drawing of an older version than the entity's is given what it can hold, as AutoCAD's SAVEAS to that version gives it: the overrides of a dimension style (ACAD DSTYLE) of a variable the version has not are left out, as DIMLTYPE of R2007 on a dimension added to a drawing of R2000, and so are the groups the version has not of the records of the tables copied by name with it, as a DIMSTYLE's DIMFXLEN (49) and a LAYER's material (347). A table's block cell keeps the values it gives the attributes of a block that comes with it, its pointers (331) naming the copies of their definitions; a LEADER whose annotation does not come with it points to none. An INSERT in a block brought that names a block its drawing has not, as a drawing read from a file may hold, is copied as it is, naming it, and said in one Debug line of : the other drawing's M holding INSERTs of Z and K, which it has not, an INSERT of M copied in says that two INSERTs name a block their drawing has not, K and Z. copies entities together, what points from one to another kept.

member.exception: Thrown when the entity is null.

Thrown when the file's version cannot hold the entity's type or look, or its linetype is not in the file's linetype table; or when it is an INSERT that would make this block insert itself at any depth; or when it is a copy of another drawing's entity whose blocks would, once brought, insert themselves or this block, an INSERT here of a block this drawing has not placing the one brought of that name: an INSERT, or a dimension whose *D holds an INSERT that closes such a round. Nothing is written then.

member.name: T:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDatabase
member.summary: Copying entities of the drawing together, as AutoCAD's Database.WblockCloneObjects copies the objects of ids.

A DXF file opened to be edited and saved again, as AutoCAD's Database is a drawing: its model space, paper space and blocks, its layers and linetypes, and its header; every byte of what is not changed kept as it was read.

remarks.para: Opened and saved with nothing changed, a file is written back byte for byte, whatever its version (R12 to R2018), line ends, padding, code page or the sections and entities the library does not read. A change writes the records it is about anew in the file's own style, and every other record keeps its bytes.
The objects are used directly, as AutoCAD's are inside a transaction; there is no ObjectId and no transaction:
A file is read as reads it, a binary DXF and one cut short refused with its messages; its coordinates are the file's own, no unit scaled. Editing is for one thread at a time.

member.summary: The dimension variables AutoCAD's Database has as properties, those new dimensions take, each a variable of the HEADER section read and set as is: is $DIMASZ, $DIMFXL. Where the header gives none, the value of AutoCAD's metric drawing (acadiso.dwt), which a new drawing of ezdxf 1.4.5 is given too: arrowheads and texts 2.5, extension lines 1.25 past the dimension line and 0.625 off the points, a gap of 0.625, two decimal places, a comma, trailing zeros left out, the text above the line. A variable R2000 (AC1015), R2004 (AC1018), R2007 (AC1021) or R2010 (AC1024) brought is refused in a file of an older version, as AutoCAD writes none there, and reads there as a dimension style of that file reads it, AutoCAD's own of acad.dwt (DIMDEC 4, DIMDSEP '.' and no text style in a file of R12), so that the header's data and a style's agree. Values are as AutoCAD's .NET gives them, as 's are: a colour as a , an arrowhead as the block it is drawn with (the header naming it), a linetype or the text style as its record; in radians, as the header holds it. gives them as a style in no table, and takes those of a style.

The settings of display and modelling in 3D AutoCAD's Database has as properties, each a variable of the HEADER section read and set as is: shading, hidden lines and their colours, the frames of underlays and clipped references, cameras and walking, lofting, the place under the sun, shadows, materials and visual styles. Where the header gives none, the value a new drawing of ezdxf 1.4.5 is given, but for the size of a polysolid, which is that of AutoCAD's metric drawing, and the objects named, which are null. A variable R2004 (AC1018) or R2007 (AC1021) brought is refused in a file of an older version, as AutoCAD writes none there.
What AutoCAD's Database keeps in the extension dictionaries of model space and of the layer table: the drawing's geographic location, its layer filters and its layer states.
Linetypes and multiline styles loaded from AutoCAD's files of them, as AutoCAD's Database loads them.
The fonts the drawing's words are measured in, as AutoCAD finds them on its support path.

The variables of the header AutoCAD's Database has as properties, each read from its variable of the HEADER section and set in it, every other byte of the header kept; where the header gives none, the value a new drawing of ezdxf 1.4.5 is given. Set to the value it has, a variable changes nothing; one the header has not is added at its end.

Keeping the drawing tidy, as AutoCAD's Database does: its empty objects counted and erased, the references to its objects counted, what nothing uses found for purging, and its extents worked out anew.
Another drawing inserted into this one, as AutoCAD's Database.Insert inserts a database.
Multiline styles made in code, as AutoCAD's MlineStyle is added to the dictionary of multiline styles.
The objects of the OBJECTS section AutoCAD's Database reaches by their ids: the named object dictionary and the dictionaries named in it, the layouts, and the properties of the drawing (DWGPROPS).
The hatch pattern files the drawing's hatches take their lines from, as AutoCAD finds them on its support path.
Repairing a drawing, as AutoCAD's RECOVER opens a damaged file and its AUDIT checks an open drawing.

The settings of drafting AutoCAD's Database has as properties, each a variable of the HEADER section read and set as is: chamfers and fillets, elevation and thickness, multilines, the limits and extents of paper space, the user's own variables, the modes of the drawing and what it says of itself. Where the header gives none, the value a new drawing of ezdxf 1.4.5 is given, but for the extents of paper space, the origin as for model space, the maintenance release, nought, and the multiline style, null where the drawing has none of the name. A variable R2000 (AC1015) or R2004 (AC1018) brought is refused in a file of an older version, as AutoCAD writes none there; it reads as where the header gives none. A text is read as the header writes it, its spaces kept.

The times the header keeps, as AutoCAD's Database gives them: when the drawing was made and last saved, how long it has been edited, and the time zone of its place. A date is written as AutoCAD writes it, a Julian day and the part of the day gone since midnight: 2451545.75 is 1 January 2000 at 18:00.

The user coordinate systems of model space and paper space the header keeps, as AutoCAD's Database has them: the current one's origin and axes ($UCSORG, $UCSXDIR, $UCSYDIR, and $PUCS of paper space), its name, the UCS the orthographic ones are taken from, and the origins of those six. A UCS is given by the name of its record of the UCS table, .

The system variables AutoCAD's Database has as properties and keeps out of the HEADER section: each a DICTIONARYVAR of the dictionary AcDbVariableDictionary of the named object dictionary, its value the text of its group 1, as AutoCAD writes it; or the header's variable of the same name, where a file keeps one there. Where the drawing gives none, the value AutoCAD gives a new drawing.
member.remarks: Setting db.Cannoscale = "1:50" writes 1:50 into the DICTIONARYVAR CANNOSCALE, every other byte of the file kept; where the drawing has none, as a drawing of ezdxf, the DICTIONARYVAR is added, owned by the dictionary AcDbVariableDictionary, which is added to the named object dictionary where that has none, as AutoCAD adds them; and where the CLASSES section lists no DICTIONARYVAR, as in a drawing the library made new, the class is listed as AutoCAD 2021 lists it. A value the variable has changes nothing. A file of R12, or one with no CLASSES section, has none to set.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDatabase.WblockCloneObjects(System.Collections.Generic.IEnumerable{GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfEntity},GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfBlockTableRecord)
member.summary: Copies entities of this drawing into a block of another drawing, or of this one, together, as AutoCAD's WblockCloneObjects copies the objects of ids: each as copies it, added to the block as adds one, with what it brings (its layer, linetype, text and dimension styles, the blocks it is drawn by); and what one of them points to among the others pointing to the copy of that other, as AutoCAD's map of ids keeps it across the objects copied together.

remarks.para: A HATCH copied with every object its loops follow follows their copies, and is associative, as the HATCH is; with some of them left behind it follows none, as a HATCH copied alone. A MULTILEADER of a block copied with an INSERT places the copy of its block and draws its arrows by the copies of theirs, where those blocks come along, as a block W holding a multileader of the block GKTAG and an INSERT of GKTAG brings GKTAG; so too an ACAD_TABLE points to the copies of its picture and of the blocks of its cells, and a LEADER or a dimension whose dimension style is overridden with an arrow block (DIMLDRBLK, DIMBLK, DIMBLK1, DIMBLK2) names the copy of that block, whichever of the two is copied first: a block W holding the leader with DIMLDRBLK GKTAG brings GKTAG after W, and the copy of the leader names it. A LEADER copied with the MTEXT, TOLERANCE or INSERT it points to points to its copy; copied alone into another drawing, it brings that annotation with it, which it points at by a hard pointer (340), as AutoCAD 2021's WblockCloneObjects brought the MTEXT of a leader copied alone, the copy of the annotation not among those given back; copied alone within this drawing, it points to none ( ). A handle of extended data (1005) naming an entity copied with it names that entity's copy; one naming anything else is null (0) in a copy into another drawing, in its place, as AutoCAD keeps it. The field of a text's words (), and of each attribute of an INSERT copied, is copied with it and listed in the drawing's list of fields. No GROUP is copied, as AutoCAD 2021's WblockCloneObjects copies none: copies them.

Every copy is checked to be one the block's drawing can hold before any is added, so that a copy refused changes nothing: a SPLINE into a drawing of R12 refuses the whole set, and so does a block the copies bring that would insert itself once written, by its own INSERTs or theirs, through the blocks of the drawing copied into: that drawing's P holding an INSERT of M, a block it has not (as a drawing read from a file may), and this drawing's M an INSERT of P, an INSERT of M copied would bring an M that places P, which places that M, without end. A set whose INSERTs would bring blocks that come back to the block they are added to is refused too. A block AutoCAD names itself that one entity of the set brings takes no name an INSERT in a block another brings gives of a block neither drawing has, as a block one entity brings takes none of its own: this drawing having *U1 and *U2, and the other's Q an INSERT of *U3, which it has not, an INSERT of its *U1 copied with one of Q brings *U1 as *U4, and Q's INSERT of *U3 places nothing, as where it came from. INSERTs of blocks their drawing has not, in the blocks the set brings, are copied as they are and said in one Debug line for the set. An MTEXT added to a drawing of R12 is written as TEXTs, as writes it, and its place in the list given back is the MTEXT itself, in no file. A block AutoCAD names itself that several of the entities draw by is copied once for the call, as AutoCAD's map of ids keeps one: two INSERTs of one *U1 copied together place one copy, and copied by two calls a copy each.

A dynamic INSERT copied into another drawing of R2010 (AC1024) or later stays dynamic, as keeps it: the dynamic block it places comes with it, or the one its anonymous block stands for where it places a *U, as AutoCAD's deep clone brings it by the pointer of the INSERT's representation, and then what makes them dynamic, as that Insert copies it. An INSERT of GH_PANEL set to a Width of 200, copied alone into a new drawing, brings *U1 and GH_PANEL, reads Width 200 and is set again as the one it was copied from. A block of the name the drawing has is its own: the copies stand for it where it is dynamic, and are static otherwise; a drawing older than R2010 takes a static copy of the INSERT's block alone, as before.

A viewport clipped by an entity () copied together with that entity names its copy (group 340), which lists the copy as its only reactor; copied alone into another drawing it brings the entity, appended after it and not among those given back, and copied alone within this drawing it keeps naming its original's entity, which does not list it, as AutoCAD 2021's WblockCloneObjects and DeepCloneObjects leave them.

A rectangle of four LINEs with a HATCH that follows them, copied together into another drawing, comes out as four LINEs and a HATCH that follows those four, each LINE listing the HATCH among its reactors.

member.param: The entities, of this drawing and not erased, each once.
The block of model space, paper space or a block of a drawing the copies are added to.
member.returns: The copies, in the order of the entities given.
member.exception: Thrown when the entities or the block are null.

Thrown when an entity is null, given twice, erased, of another drawing, or a record that follows another (a VERTEX or an ATTRIB); or when the block's drawing cannot hold a copy, as says; or when a block the copies bring would insert itself, or make the block insert itself, at any depth, which AutoCAD's AUDIT takes out. Nothing is added then.
Thrown when the block is in no drawing.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDatabase.#ctor(System.String)
member.summary:
Makes a new drawing with nothing in it, of a version, as AutoCAD's new Database(true, true) makes one of its own: the drawing writes with no shape, in millimetres, with model space and paper space, two layouts, the layer 0, the text style Standard, the dimension styles Standard and ISO-25 and the named object dictionary, its header naming the version given ($ACADVER) and its records giving what that version added to them, as AutoCAD writes them: from R2004 on how many objects of each class there are, without which AutoCAD opens no drawing of those versions, and the layouts' shade plot; from R2007 on the unit, explodability and scaling of model space and paper space. new DxfDatabase("AC1024") is a drawing of R2010, the oldest a dynamic block is made in (); "AC1015" gives the very text new DxfWriter().ToString() gives, but for ISO-25 (below) and the code page its header names after the version ($DWGCODEPAGE ANSI_1252), as AutoCAD's own empty drawings of every version from R2000 name it: so that a reader that goes by it, as ezdxf does, takes the text of a drawing of R2007 or later, Korean text copied into it among it, for the UTF-8 it is written in, which it took for ANSI_1252 without it.
ISO-25 is current, as in AutoCAD 2021's metric template acadiso.dwt saved as each of these versions: $DIMSTYLE names it and the header and the style hold the same values, arrowheads and text 2.5, a gap of 0.625, two decimal places and a decimal comma, each of the 20 that differ from AutoCAD's own written into both, as AutoCAD writes them; Standard holds AutoCAD's own (arrowheads 0.18), as acadiso.dwt's does. So gives ISO-25 in every variable, and AutoCAD, which reads a variable the header leaves out as its imperial drawing has it, reads the same.
member.param: The version, as names it: AC1015 (R2000), AC1018 (R2004), AC1021 (R2007), AC1024 (R2010), AC1027 (R2013) or AC1032 (R2018), letters of either case.
member.exception: Thrown when the version is null.
Thrown when the version is none of those six: a drawing of R12 to R14 is not made this way, its records not those of the writer's drawing.

A string is text already read, so one of an earlier version with letters beyond ASCII is kept in the code page its header names ($DWGCODEPAGE, ANSI_1252 where it names none), as AutoCAD would have saved it, each letter the page lacks as its escape, and what is changed is written so too: an MTEXT café Đ in a text of R2004 of the page ANSI_1252 is saved as caf, the byte E9 and \U+0110, which AutoCAD 2021 reads as café Đ. Saved as the UTF-8 of the string, as the library did before, AutoCAD 2021 read é as Ã© and refused a drawing with a layer of such a name. A file is best opened from its bytes all the same, which are kept as they are.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDatabase.Save(System.String,System.String)
member.summary: Saves the drawing to a path in a version of AutoCAD, as AutoCAD's SaveAs(path, version) does, replacing whatever is there: R12 (AC1009), R2000 (AC1015), R2004 (AC1018), R2007 (AC1021), R2010 (AC1024), R2013 (AC1027) or R2018 (AC1032). The drawing in the memory stays as it is, of its own version; is the path from then on.
member.param: The version, as names it, letters of either case.
member.returns: What could not be written in the version, a sentence each: the kinds left out and the kinds written another way; empty where nothing was.
member.exception: Thrown when the path or the version is null.
Thrown when the version is none of those seven.
Thrown when the drawing is of R12 to R14 and the version is not its own: its records are not those of R2000 and later, and are saved as they are.
Thrown when the file cannot be written.

remarks.para: A drawing saved in its own version is written as writes it, byte for byte. Saved in another, every kind of entity and object stays, as AutoCAD keeps them when it saves an older version, with the groups the version has: the header variables, the true colours and transparency before R2004, the background of an MTEXT, the gradient of a hatch, the lighting of a viewport and the other groups a later version brought are left out, and the counts of each class of objects, which AutoCAD opens no drawing from R2004 on without, are made. A drawing of R2000 saved as R2018 is given what R2018 writes that it did not hold, and no more.

What cannot be given the form of the older version is left out or written another way, and said in the result: a table, whose cells are in a form of their own on either side of R2007, is written as the block it is drawn with; the visual styles, which have a form of their own in each version but R2013 and R2018, are left out, and AutoCAD makes its own on opening; the ACIS body of a solid of R2013 or later, binary, cannot be written as the text of R2010 and before (a REGION it can: its body is read and written again for each version, SAT text up to R2010 and the data store from R2013); the columns of an MTEXT and the lines of an attribute, which R2018 holds in an object embedded in it, are written as R2013 writes them. Text beyond the code page of a drawing before R2007 is written as the escapes \U+XXXX, as keeps it.

R12 has no objects, no classes, no layouts beyond one paper space, no handles but those of its entities, and a few of the kinds of entity: it is written as AutoCAD 2021 writes one drawing as R12. The header, the tables (no block records, no handles, no extended data, names as R12 holds them, a TrueType font named txt, a dimension style with every value) and the groups of each entity are those of R12; the spaces are the blocks $MODEL_SPACE and $PAPER_SPACE; a viewport keeps its view in its extended data (ACAD MVIEW). What R12 lacks is broken into what it holds: an LWPOLYLINE is a POLYLINE, an ellipse (129 vertices) and a spline (128) a 3D POLYLINE, a ray and an infinite line a LINE to the extents of the drawing; an MTEXT (its words laid out in the of the drawing, so that a long one is wrapped as AutoCAD wraps it), a pattern HATCH, a LEADER, a MULTILEADER, an MLINE, a table, a MESH (its edges) and a HATCH filled solid or with a gradient (its SOLIDs, one colour for a gradient) are the entities they break into, and a 3DSOLID and a REGION the lines, circles, arcs, points and 3D polylines of the edges of their faces (a box 40 by 30 by 20 is 24 LINEs; an edge that is a spline is left out), in a block *U or *X numbered on in the order of the handles, where they stood in a space and where they stood in a block alike (a ray and an infinite line in a block are a LINE of no length); the INSERT is on the current layer and in the current colour of the drawing, and that of a hatch holds the hatch as R14 did in its extended data (ACAD HATCH, R14_HATCH_DATA), that of a multileader its version (ACAD_MLEADERVER). A dynamic block is written as the anonymous block *U AutoCAD gives it, and a name R12 does not allow is an underscore for each character it does not and cut to 26 characters. A TOLERANCE, a WIPEOUT, an IMAGE, an underlay, an OLE frame and the layouts beyond the first are left out, and said.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDatabase.SetDimstyleData(GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDimStyleTableRecord)
member.summary: Makes the variables of a dimension style those new dimensions take, as AutoCAD's SetDimstyleData: each that differs from the header's written into it, those it holds already writing nothing; is left as it is. A variable the header of the file's version has not is passed over whatever the record holds, as AutoCAD's SAVEAS to that version leaves it out: DIMDEC in a file of R12, and DIMARCSYM, which a style holds from R2000 and the header from R2007, in one of R2000 (a dimension's and a leader's SetDimstyleData refuse such a variable where the record holds another value than AutoCAD's own). A whole number is checked against AutoCAD's range, as each property checks it. A record that names no text style leaves as it is. Every value is checked before any is written.
member.param: The record: of the , or made in code, as gives one.
member.exception: Thrown when the record is null.
Thrown when a value of the record is one AutoCAD does not take, a of 9.
Thrown when a block, linetype or text style of the record is of another drawing.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDatabase.LoadLineTypeFile(System.String,System.String)
member.summary: Loads linetypes from a file of linetypes, as AutoCAD's LoadLineTypeFile loads them from acad.lin: each linetype of the name given added to the with its description and dashes, a dash's text or shape with its style, scale, rotation and offset, as writes them.

remarks.para: A linetype of the file is *NAME,description on a line and its pattern on the next: A, then the lengths of its dashes, above nought a dash, below a gap, nought a dot, and a dash's text or shape in brackets after it, ["GAS",STANDARD,S=.1,U=0.0,X=-0.1,Y=-.05] or [CIRC1,ltypeshp.shx,x=-.1,s=.1]; a line that begins with a semicolon is a comment. AutoCAD's gas line, A,.5,-.2,["GAS",STANDARD,S=.1,U=0.0,X=-0.1,Y=-.05],-.25, is three dashes and 0.95 long, its gap of 0.2 carrying the text GAS, written 49 -0.2, 74 2, 75 0, 340 the handle of Standard, 46 0.1, 50 0, 44 -0.1, 45 -0.05, 9 GAS. A rotation R or U is from the line and A from the x axis, in degrees, or radians with r after it, grads with g.

A text is drawn in the text style the file names, which the drawing is to have. A shape is drawn from the file of shapes the file names, in the drawing's style of that file, added with no name (70 of 1) where it has none, as AutoCAD adds one; a shape named rather than numbered is found by its name in that compiled file (.shx), in the folder of the file of linetypes. A file of R12 has no complex linetypes.

The name may hold the wildcards * and ?, * loading every linetype of the file: those the drawing has already, and those it cannot take (a style or shape it has not, more than 12 dashes), are passed over, the log saying which in one line. A name with no wildcard is loaded or refused.

member.param: The name of the linetype, letters of either case the same, or a pattern of them.
The path of the file of linetypes.
member.exception: Thrown when the name or the path is null.

Thrown, for a name with no wildcard, when the file has no linetype of the name or cannot be read there, the drawing has a linetype of the name already (AutoCAD's eDuplicateRecordName), or the linetype is one the drawing cannot take: a text style it has not, a shape not found, more than 12 dashes, a complex linetype in a file of R12 or in one that writes no handles to point at its styles by, or no linetype table to hold it. Every dash is checked first, so that a linetype refused adds nothing, not even the style of a file of shapes.
Thrown when the file cannot be read, a where there is none.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDatabase.LoadMlineStyleFile(System.String,System.String)
member.summary: Loads a multiline style from a file of them, as AutoCAD's LoadMlineStyleFile loads one from acad.mln: an MLINESTYLE of the style's groups added to the dictionary of multiline styles () under its name, as a , written as AutoCAD writes one: 100 AcDbMlineStyle, then its name (2), flags (70), description (3), fill (62), angles (51, 52), count of elements (71) and each element's offset (49), colour (62) and linetype (6), as the file gives them. A drawing with no dictionary of multiline styles is given one, ACAD_MLINESTYLE of its named object dictionary.
member.remarks: A style of the file is opened by MLSTYLE and given as its groups, each a code on one line and its value on the next, up to a group 0, as AutoCAD writes acad.mln; its STANDARD is two elements 0.5 either side of the line, by layer.
member.param: The name of the style, letters of either case the same.
The path of the file of multiline styles.
member.exception: Thrown when the name or the path is null.
Thrown when the file has no style of the name, the drawing's dictionary has one of it already, or an element is drawn with a linetype the drawing has not.
Thrown when the file does not give a group code where it should.
Thrown when the drawing has no named object dictionary, as one of R12.
Thrown when the file cannot be read, a where there is none.

member.name: P:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDatabase.FontSearchPath
member.summary: Gets or sets the folders the SHX and TrueType fonts of the drawing's text styles are looked for in, separated by semicolons and searched in their order, as AutoCAD looks for them on its support path; empty, as a drawing is opened or made, for none.

value.para: Empty, no font is read and every entity is laid out as the library lays it out without fonts: nothing is read from the disk and nothing is logged. Given folders, a style's font file (romans.shx, txt read as txt.shx, arial.ttf) is read from the first that holds it, once, and the words of the drawing are measured in it where AutoCAD 2021 needs their width to place what it places by them, as it measures them: a TEXT, ATTRIB or ATTDEF justified other than left on its baseline stands where its words put it about its second point, and an aligned or fitted one takes the height or width its two points give; its are its words' ink; an MTEXT is laid out in lines, its paragraphs wrapped at its width, and gives the , , and exploded TEXTs of them (check F4); a multileader lands a leader on the right of its words of one line; an attribute definition is taken into a flip. "ABC" of txt.shx, 4 high and centred on (100, 50, 0), stands at (94.667, 50, 0), the ink of its letters 10.667 wide, and of arial.ttf at (94.259, 50, 0); with no fonts it stays where it stood.

A TrueType font (.ttf, .ttc or .otf) is measured as AutoCAD 2021 measures it (checks F1a and F2): a text's height the top of the font's A, no pair of letters kerned, a TEXT boxed from the start of its baseline to its last pen, its bottom on the font's usWinDescent, and %%c the font's diameter sign, else its Ø. A style that names a typeface () is measured where its file is that typeface, bold and italic as the style says, as AutoCAD draws the style by its typeface; a collection (.ttc) by its first face, where the style names it.

A style's big font () is read from the same folders and its letters drawn beside the style's SHX font as AutoCAD 2021 draws them (check F3): a text's letters read in the code page AutoCAD gives the big font's name, GBK for gbcbig.shx, Big5 for chineset.shx, Shift-JIS for bigfont.shx, extfont.shx, extfont2.shx and @extfont2.shx, and Korean for whgtxt.shx, whgdtxt.shx, whtgtxt.shx and whtmtxt.shx, so that 中 is gbcbig.shx's D6D0 and chineset.shx's A4A4; a letter of two bytes the big font has drawn from it, but °, ± and ∅; a byte alone the font's letter, else the big font's; a space the big font's where it has one; and a letter neither font has the big font's question mark where it has one. "A中B" of txt.shx and gbcbig.shx, 4 high and centred on (100, 50, 0), stands at (95.211, 50, 0), as AutoCAD puts it. A big font of another name, or named with its folder, AutoCAD reads in no code page, and its texts are measured where every letter is of ASCII. On .NET, not .NET Framework, the code pages of big fonts are read where CodePagesEncodingProvider is registered, as for a DXF of them. A TrueType style's big font is not drawn.

The results follow the fonts supplied, so that they differ between machines and between versions of a font, as AutoCAD's drawings do. Fonts of shapes are not measured, nor one beside a big font, a multibyte code (\M+) beside a big font, TrueType fonts of CFF outlines or of symbols, a style named by its typeface alone, one of another typeface than its file, and a collection a style names by no typeface: a style of one, or of a font in none of the folders, lays its words out as with no fonts, the log saying so at Debug once a file, and a file that is found but is no font, or cannot be read, is said at Warn; nothing throws. Each set reads the fonts anew; shares one set. An empty text () is a TEXT whose words are empty or spaces, and an MTEXT whose words without their formatting are; an attribute and its definition are not texts here.

An INSERT of the other drawing that names a block it has not, as a drawing read from a file may hold, is copied as it is, naming that block, wherever it stands, in its model space or in a block merged or brought, as AutoCAD 2021's Insert copies one, placing nothing; where this drawing has a block of the name, the copy places it. One Debug line of says how many there were. The other's M holding a line and an INSERT of Z, which it has not, gives this drawing M with its INSERT of Z.

A dynamic block stays dynamic, as AutoCAD's own insert keeps it: its record's extended data (AcDbDynamicBlockTrueName, AcDbDynamicBlockGUID, AcDbBlockRepETag) and the evaluation graph and purge preventer of its extension dictionary come with it, each anonymous block standing for it keeps its AcDbBlockRepBTag, and each INSERT its representation data and the values it keeps, every object copied under a handle of its own here and every handle among them naming the copies; the classes of the objects are listed. A block GH_PANEL of a Width of 100 with an INSERT of it set to 200 comes as GH_PANEL, dynamic, with an INSERT that reads Width 200 and is set again as the one it was copied from. A dynamic block of a name this drawing has is this drawing's own: the INSERTs copied stand for it where it is dynamic, and are static copies otherwise; and a drawing older than R2010 (AC1024), which the library writes no dynamic block into, takes them all static.

Every entity is checked before anything is written, its copy and its copy moved, so that a drawing this one cannot hold, a SPLINE into one of R12 or an INSERT the transformation would shear, changes nothing; nor does a drawing whose model space holds an entity of a type the library has no class for (, as a SHAPE or a REGION), by any transformation but the identity, nor one holding an OLE2FRAME by one that would turn it. The extents of the header grow by the entities where they are moved to. The other drawing is left as it is.

member.name: P:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDatabase.SummaryInfo
member.summary: Gets or sets the properties of the drawing, as AutoCAD's SummaryInfo: those of its DWGPROPS, the XRECORD of the named object dictionary AutoCAD keeps them in, its title (group 2), subject (3), author (4), comments (6), keywords (7), who saved it last (8), its revision (9), the base of its hyperlinks (the group 1 after its dates) and its custom properties: each name=value in a group 300 to 309, then those of a list after the group 90 that follows the base of the hyperlinks, where one follows it, each a name and a value in two groups 1, then each name=value in a group 300 after those, as AutoCAD 2021 saved the eleventh and twelfth of twelve. The base of the hyperlinks is the header's $HYPERLINKBASE where that is not empty, as AutoCAD 2021 reads it there. A drawing with no DWGPROPS, as AutoCAD saves one of R2004 or later, gives the texts of its header, $TITLE, $SUBJECT, $AUTHOR, $COMMENTS, $KEYWORDS and $REVISIONNUMBER, and its custom properties, each the value of a $CUSTOMPROPERTYTAG and of the $CUSTOMPROPERTY after it, in their order: AutoCAD 2021 saved a drawing of R2018 titled Plate B-12, of the custom properties Project and Checked by, with $TITLE, $AUTHOR and two such pairs after $DWGCODEPAGE, and no DWGPROPS. Empty where the drawing has none.

value.para: Set in a drawing of R2004 (AC1018) or later, written in its header as AutoCAD 2021 writes a drawing of R2018: each text not empty in its variable, $TITLE, $SUBJECT, $AUTHOR, $KEYWORDS, $COMMENTS and $REVISIONNUMBER, then a $CUSTOMPROPERTYTAG and a $CUSTOMPROPERTY for each custom property, as many as there are, after $DWGCODEPAGE, the header's $LASTSAVEDBY moved among them before $REVISIONNUMBER, its value kept, as AutoCAD 2021 wrote the header of R2004, R2010 and R2018; an empty text has no variable, and the base of the hyperlinks goes to $HYPERLINKBASE. A DWGPROPS the drawing has is taken out, as AutoCAD 2021 saved one of R2018 read with a DWGPROPS without it; who saved it last is not written but kept.

Set in a drawing of R13 to R2000, the DWGPROPS written anew, as AutoCAD 2021 writes one of R2000 and reads it back: its marker DWGPROPS COOKIE (1), the texts, the custom properties in the ten groups 300 to 309 (= where there is none), the time spent on it and the dates it was made and saved (40, 41, 42, those of a DWGPROPS kept, else the header's $TDINDWG, $TDCREATE and $TDUPDATE), the base of its hyperlinks and the count of the custom properties (90), and each after the tenth in a group 300 after the count, as AutoCAD 2021 saved twelve as R2000 and read them back; the groups after those kept as they were. A list of them after the group 90 of two groups 1 each, which AutoCAD 2021 does not read, is written no more. The base of the hyperlinks is written to the header's $HYPERLINKBASE too, in a drawing of R2000, and each text the header holds already is set there as well, so that the two agree. A drawing with none is given one, owned by the named object dictionary. Properties the same as the drawing has change nothing, in a drawing of any version.
db.SummaryInfo = new DxfDatabaseSummaryInfoBuilder(db.SummaryInfo) { Title = "Plate B-12" }.ToDatabaseSummaryInfo() gives the drawing its title, its other properties kept.

member.exception: Thrown when the properties set are null.
Thrown when set in a drawing older than R2004 with a custom property whose name has an equals sign in it.
Thrown when set in a file of R12, or one older than R2004 with no named object dictionary.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDatabase.GetObject(System.String)
member.summary: Gets the object of a handle, as AutoCAD's GetObjectId(false, handle, 0) gives its id: an entity of model space, paper space or a block (a VERTEX of a POLYLINE and an ATTRIB of an INSERT among them), an object of the OBJECTS section, a record of the layer, linetype, text style, dimension style or block table, or one of those five tables; letters of either case the same. db.GetObject("2F") of a drawing whose layer steel has the handle 2F gives that .
member.remarks: The library has no class for the other records that carry a handle, and finds none of them: the tables of applications (APPID), viewports (VPORT), views (VIEW) and coordinate systems (UCS) and their records, and the BLOCK and ENDBLK that open and close a block. The objects are found by handle in one walk of the drawing, kept until the drawing next changes, so that many questions between two changes cost one walk.
member.param: The handle, as the file writes it, hexadecimal.
member.returns: The object.
member.exception: Thrown when the handle is null.
Thrown when the drawing has no object of the handle, or it is erased, as AutoCAD answers eUnknownHandle.

member.exception: Thrown when the handle is null.

member.summary: The object of the OBJECTS section of a handle, as finds it, without the walk of every entity that looks for an entity first: for a handle known to be an object's, such as a table style's. Null where there is none, the handle is not hexadecimal, or the object is erased.

member.name: P:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDatabase.ApproxNumObjects
member.summary: Gets how many objects the drawing holds, as AutoCAD's ApproxNumObjects: those finds by handle, the entities of every space and block with their vertices and attributes, the objects of the OBJECTS section, and the five tables it reads with their records; those erased left out. AutoCAD counts the records of the tables the library has no class for as well (APPID, VPORT, VIEW, UCS) and the BLOCK and ENDBLK of each block, so its number is somewhat higher. A drawing of R12 that writes no handles counts none. The drawing is walked once for each question, its entities and its records under the lock takes, so that it may be asked while other threads copy from it or look objects up by handle.

They are found by handle in one walk, made again once the records change, under the lock takes, as several threads may look them up at once.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDatabase.IndexOthers
member.summary: Finds the records of the tables, the tables and the records that follow an entity by their handles, in one walk: the tables in the order layer, linetype, text style, dimension style and block, each before its records, then the followers; the first of a handle kept.

The entities are found by handle in one walk of the drawing, and those appended since are taken in as they are asked for: an entity appended between two questions costs no walk, so that a loop that appends to a drawing and to a group stays linear. A handle found erased is looked for again by a walk, once for each change of the records, as an entity converted keeps its handle in a record of its own.

member.name: P:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDatabase.PatternSearchPath
member.summary: Gets or sets the folders the hatch pattern files (.pat) are looked for in, separated by semicolons and searched in their order, as AutoCAD looks for them on its support path; empty, as a drawing is opened or made, for none.

value.para: Empty, no pattern file is read: a HATCH given a pattern of AutoCAD's file by holds no lines of it ( 0), its name written for AutoCAD to take the lines from its own file, and nothing is read from the disk or logged. Given folders, a HATCH of the drawing given a pattern by , or one made in code given it before it is added to the drawing, is given the lines of the pattern as AutoCAD 2021 gives them (check P4c): from acadiso.pat in a drawing of millimetres ( , as the library reads a header that gives none, which AutoCAD 2021 opens as one of inches) and acad.pat in one of inches, or from a file named after the pattern (GRID.pat for GRID); a pattern of AutoCAD's file looked for in the drawing's file first and a custom one in its own file first, each file read once from the first folder that has it, and the type the pattern is written as () that of the file it is found in, its name in capitals, as AutoCAD writes them. Each line is turned by the HATCH's and scaled by its about the origin of its plane, and written anew from the file when either is set, so that and draw it: ANSI31 of acadiso.pat, 45, 0,0, 0,3.175, is the one line at 45 degrees through (0, 0), offset (-2.245, 2.245), and a square 30 by 20 of it explodes to 11 LINEs; of acad.pat, 45, 0,0, 0,.125, offset (-0.0884, 0.0884); at scale 2 and angle 30 degrees, at 75 degrees, offset (-6.134, 1.644). adds no line to such a pattern, as AutoCAD adds none. Every pattern of AutoCAD 2021's two files, at three scales and angles, gives the lines AutoCAD gives to 1E-13 (918 hatches), and on squares off the origin AutoCAD draws them, and breaks them, into AutoCAD's own LINEs, 84 034 of 84 034.

A pattern file is read as AutoCAD 2021 reads one: a pattern begins at a line starting *, its name all before the first comma, and runs to the next; comments from a ;, blank lines and the blanks about numbers are passed over, and the first pattern of a name is taken, whatever its case. A pattern AutoCAD refuses is refused: one with a line of fewer than five numbers or more than six dashes, or a number that cannot be read, or one of no line. A HATCH read from a file keeps the lines the file gives it, a pattern made by the user (_USER) is made as before, and a pattern found in no file, or refused, is left with no lines as with no folders, the log saying so at Debug once a pattern, and a pattern refused, or a file that cannot be read, at Warn; nothing throws. Each set reads the files anew. No folder is looked in that is not given, and no file of AutoCAD's is carried by the library: the results follow the files supplied.

member.exception: Thrown when the path set is null.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDatabase.Recover(System.String,GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfRepairReport@)
member.summary: Opens a damaged DXF file from a path, as AutoCAD's RECOVER opens one: what can be read of it, repaired, with a report of what was found and done. A sound file is opened as opens it, every byte kept, with an empty report.
member.param: What was found wrong and what was done, in the order it was found.
member.returns: The drawing; never null.
member.exception: Thrown when the path is null.
Thrown when the file cannot be read.
Thrown for a binary DXF, which is not damaged but not read: save it as an ASCII DXF.

remarks.para: The file is read as pairs of lines whatever is wrong with them, then put right where it can be, in the order of : a line that is not a group code left out; a file cut short closed with its ENDSEC and EOF; the sections closed and put in order, ENTITIES added where there is none; the text of a file of R2007 or later that is not UTF-8 read in its code page; a number that is no number given the number it begins with, or nought; an entity with a number that is not finite left out; the counts of a LWPOLYLINE and a HATCH set to their parts; a handle two records have, or one missing, given a new one; an owner that names nothing pointed at the block, table or polyline the record stands in; an ENDBLK, a SEQEND and $HANDSEED written where missing. The file so written is then opened, and audited as audits it, fixing: layers, linetypes, text styles and dimension styles the entities name and the tables lack are added; a broken entry of a dictionary is taken out. An INSERT of a block not defined, an entity of a type unknown, a missing TABLES, BLOCKS or OBJECTS section are reported and left as they are.

A drawing of R2018 of 12 INSERTs, a hatch, two polylines, a text, a dimension and three lines, cut off after the code of the first point of its last line, opens with every entity but that line whole, the line read with no point, and a report of 3 errors found, 2 fixed: the code with no value left out, the file closed with its ENDSEC and EOF, and its OBJECTS section, lost with the cut, reported. It saves as a file opens. Where what was repaired still cannot be read, its entities alone are kept, and failing that the drawing is empty; both are said in the report ().

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDatabase.Recover(System.IO.Stream,GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfRepairReport@)
member.summary: Opens a damaged DXF file from a stream, from where the stream stands to its end, as opens one from a path.
member.param: The stream; it is read to its end and left open.
What was found wrong and what was done, in the order it was found.
member.returns: The drawing; never null.
member.exception: Thrown when the stream is null.
Thrown for a binary DXF.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDatabase.Audit(System.Boolean)
member.summary: Checks the drawing for errors, as AutoCAD's AUDIT does, and fixes those it can where asked; the report says what was found and what was fixed. A sound drawing gives an empty report.
member.param: Whether to fix what can be fixed in the drawing as it stands, as AUDIT's answer Yes.
member.returns: What was found, each fixed or not.

remarks.para: Fixed where asked: a layer, linetype, text style or dimension style an entity names that its table lacks is added with the defaults (a linetype drawn solid); a number of an entity's own record that is no number is given the number it begins with, or nought, and the count of a LWPOLYLINE's vertices or a HATCH's boundary paths set to their number; an entity with a number that is not finite is erased; a broken entry of a dictionary (a name with no pointer, a pointer with no name or one that is not a handle) is taken out. A drawing whose line 0 to 100 stands on the layer WALLS, which its layer table does not list, gives one error, and fixed, the layer WALLS of colour 7 and the linetype Continuous.

Found and not fixed here: an INSERT of a block not defined and an entity of a type neither AutoCAD's own nor named in the CLASSES section, both kept; and what the file itself would need written again, a handle two records have, an owner that names nothing, a $HANDSEED too low, a number of a vertex or an attribute that is no number, which fixes as it reads the saved drawing again.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDatabase.Repaired(GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfRecovery,System.String,System.Collections.Generic.List{GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfRepair})
member.summary: The drawing of the repaired bytes; where they still cannot be read, the code page of the header set to ANSI_1252, then the entities alone, then an empty drawing, each said in the report.

member.name: P:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDatabase.Ucs
member.summary: Sets the current UCS of model space, as AutoCAD's Ucs: its origin and axes written to $UCSORG, $UCSXDIR and $UCSYDIR, read back by , and . A system rotated a quarter turn about Z at (100, 0, 0) writes the axes (0, 1, 0) and (-1, 0, 0). The name of the UCS, , is left as it is. A makes its axes of unit length and square, so a header whose axes are not, read into one and set back, is written with them so: $UCSXDIR of (2, 0, 0) is written (1, 0, 0).
member.exception: Thrown when the system set is not of a finite origin and unit axes at right angles, as default(GeoCoordinateSystem3) is not.

member.name: P:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDatabase.Cetransparency
member.summary: Gets or sets the transparency of new entities (CETRANSPARENCY), as AutoCAD's Cetransparency: BYLAYER where the drawing gives none. AutoCAD 2021 reads the DICTIONARYVAR as the whole number an entity's 440 holds, its top byte the method (2 by alpha, 1 BYBLOCK, 0 BYLAYER) and its low byte the alpha: the alpha 127 is 33554559. A number with no method in its top byte, as the per cent 61 the library wrote before, is BYLAYER, as AutoCAD reads it; the words ByLayer and ByBlock are read as they say.
member.value: Set, written as that number, so that the alpha 100 reads back as 100 in AutoCAD and here.
member.exception: Thrown when the transparency set is an error value, or an alpha more than 90 per cent clear.
Thrown when set in a file with no variables of the OBJECTS section to hold it.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDatabase.AttachXref(System.String,System.String)
member.summary: Attaches another drawing as an external reference, as AutoCAD's AttachXref: a block of the name given whose BLOCK is flagged an external reference (70 of 4) and names the drawing's path (its 1), with its BLOCK_RECORD from R13 on, and no entities: AutoCAD reads the drawing into it when it opens this one. An INSERT of the block places it, as new DxfBlockReference(position, xref) appended to model space; until then the block is .
member.remarks: The drawing is not read: the block's origin is the origin, and its says whether the path names a file. db.AttachXref("column.dwg", "COLUMN") writes the BLOCK 2 COLUMN, 70 4, 3 COLUMN, 1 column.dwg.
member.param: The path of the drawing, as it is to be written: absolute, or from the folder of this one.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDatabase.BindXref(GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfBlockTableRecord,GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDatabase,System.Boolean)
member.summary: Binds an external reference, as AutoCAD's BindXrefs binds one: its block made an ordinary block, its origin the base point of its drawing ($INSBASE) and its path kept, holding a copy of every entity of that drawing's model space, its INSERTs placing it as they placed the reference; and the records that drawing's entities draw by brought with them. Bound ( false), each layer, linetype, text style, dimension style and named block of the drawing comes under the reference's name, $0$ and its own, the 0 raised past a name the drawing has (GRID$1$WALL where GRID$0$WALL is taken), as AutoCAD 2021's -XREF Bind names them; layer 0, Defpoints, ByBlock, ByLayer and Continuous are this drawing's. Inserted (true), each keeps its own name and is merged by name, this drawing's own kept, as merges them.

remarks.para: The records the reference brought into this drawing (the layer GRID|WALL and the like, of the layer, linetype, text style and dimension style tables) take the new names in their places, with what this drawing set on them, as AutoCAD keeps a layer's colour changed in the drawing: GRID|WALL made red here becomes the red layer GRID$0$WALL, no longer of a reference, its AcXRefLayerPropertyOverride data taken out. Inserted, GRID|WALL becomes WALL, or goes where the drawing has a WALL of its own, what drew on it drawing on that. Blocks named after the reference are taken out, and come again from its drawing.

A drawing of a line on WALL, its base point (100, 50, 0), bound as GRID gives the block GRID drawn about (100, 50, 0) with the line on GRID$0$WALL. An external reference of the drawing an INSERT of its model space places comes with the INSERT, an external reference still, as brings one, to be bound in its turn; one overlaid is left out, as a drawing that references this one does not see it. The drawing given is left as it is: it is copied, and the copy renamed. Every entity is checked before anything is written, as Insert checks it.

member.param: The block of the external reference, of this drawing.
The drawing it references, as read from its file; another than this one.
Whether the records keep their own names (Insert) rather than coming under the reference's (Bind).
member.exception: Thrown when the block or the drawing is null.

Thrown when the block is of another drawing or is no external reference; when the drawing is this one, or, inserted, has a block of the reference's name; or when this drawing cannot hold an entity of it, or a block of it inserts itself, as Insert refuses them. Nothing is written then.
Thrown when the block is erased.
