member.name: T:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDataLink
member.summary: A DATALINK of a DXF file, as AutoCAD's DataLink: the link of a table's cells to the data of another file, a spreadsheet as a rule, kept under its name in the dictionary of data links (, ACAD_DATALINK) and named by the cells of the tables it fills ().

remarks.para: A link is read from the file, from R2007 (AC1021) on, which brought DATALINK: db.DataLinkDictionary["Parts"] is the link Parts. Only its name, the dictionary's entry, is set; the library makes no new link and changes no group of one, as no link it wrote has yet been opened in AutoCAD.

The DXF reference does not describe a DATALINK, and ezdxf keeps one as it reads it. The groups read are those LibreDWG gives AcDbDataLink: the data adapter (1), the description (300), the tooltip (301), the connection string (302), the options (90) and the update options (91); a 92 LibreDWG names no further, read here as which way the link was last updated; when (170 to 176: year, month, day, hour, minute, second, millisecond); a 177 LibreDWG calls the option of the paths; a 93 it names no further, read here as how the update went; and its status (304). AutoCAD 2021 writes them so, with no 70, and then the count (94) of the objects the link is tied to, each a 330: the table it fills and that table's TABLECONTENT, 94 2, 330 F6, 330 149; then what the link owns (360, 0 for nothing), and its custom data between 305 CUSTOMDATA, 1 DATAMAP_BEGIN, a count (90) and 309 DATAMAP_END. A table's link taken away () takes the table and what it owns out of that list, as AutoCAD's RemoveDataLink does.
The library does not read the source: updating a link, its source files and their paths, AutoCAD's Update, GetSourceFiles and RepathSourceFiles, are AutoCAD's data adapters' work, and are not here.

member.name: T:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDBDictionary
member.summary: A dictionary of a DXF file, as AutoCAD's DBDictionary: a DICTIONARY of the OBJECTS section, its entries each a name and the object it names, found by name, letters of either case the same, as AutoCAD finds one.

remarks.para: The extension dictionary an entity is given by is one, reached by : line.ExtensionDictionary.SetAt("GH_DATA", new DxfDBDictionary()) adds a dictionary named GH_DATA to it, owned by it, as AutoCAD writes one: its handle above every handle of the file, its owner as its reactor and its owner (330), the marker AcDbDictionary and its cloning (281 of 1); the entry is written last among those of the owner, its name as a 3 and the new dictionary's handle as a 350, a 360 where the owner owns its entries hard (280 of 1), as an extension dictionary does.

A dictionary holds objects of the library's classes as they come: a , a , a , a , a , a , which adds, or a , read only; the other objects of the OBJECTS section, as a MATERIAL, are read as they are. The drawing's own dictionaries are reached from , , and the others of the database.
An entry is taken out of the record when its object is erased, so there are no erased entries to walk: AutoCAD's IncludingErased has nothing to add here.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDBDictionary.SetAt(System.String,GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDBObject)
member.summary: Adds an object under a name, as AutoCAD's SetAt: an object made in code written into the file as the dictionary's own, last among its entries, as AutoCAD writes it; where the name has an entry already, the object it named is erased, with what it owns, and the entry names the new one, as AutoCAD replaces it.

remarks.para: A , a with its data and a with its description are added: db.GroupDictionary.SetAt("BEAMS", new DxfGroup("Beams of grid A", true)) adds the group BEAMS, empty until entities are appended to it. A group added under the name * is anonymous, as AutoCAD names one: it is given the first name *A1, *A2 and on the dictionary has not. A is written with every group AutoCAD writes of one: db.TableStyleDictionary.SetAt("GH_SCHEDULE", new DxfTableStyle()) adds a style of AutoCAD's Standard in millimetres. A is written with every group AutoCAD 2021 holds of one, its class listed and counted in CLASSES: db.MLeaderStyleDictionary.SetAt("GH_NOTES", new DxfMLeaderStyle { TextHeight = 2.5, ArrowSize = 2.5 }) adds a style of words and arrows 2.5 high. A is a named page setup: db.PlotSettingsDictionary.SetAt("A3 plan", new DxfPlotSettings()) adds one of an ISO A3 sheet and no plotter, named by its entry, with its class PLOTSETTINGS listed and counted in CLASSES; set it, or copy a layout's settings into it (), once it is added.

The entries are found by name without reading the record again, and the new one is put into the record's bytes as they stand, so that an entry added costs only a copy of the record: 2 000 XRECORDs added one by one to one dictionary take 0.02 s, and 10 000 take 1.1 s.

member.param: The name, letters of either case the same as an entry's.
The object, made in code and in no file yet.
member.exception: Thrown when the name or the object is null.

Thrown when the name is empty or has a control character in it, or the object is in a file already or of a class the library does not add: a , whose place is the layout dictionary, or one of no class of its own; or it is a and the name has an entry, as AutoCAD 2021's SetAt erases the definition there and leaves the images that show it out of the file it writes: add it under the name gives.
Thrown when this dictionary is in no file, or is erased.

member.name: T:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDBObject
member.summary: An object of a DXF file, as AutoCAD's DBObject is one of a drawing: an entity, a table, a record of a table. It has its handle, its owner's handle, its extended data and the handle of its extension dictionary, read from its record as the file writes it.

remarks.para: Objects are used directly, as AutoCAD's are inside a transaction, with no ObjectId and no transaction: an object read from a is the same object each time it is reached, and a change to it is written into its record at once, every other record of the file keeping its bytes.
An object made in code, such as new DxfLine(start, end), is in no file until it is added to one: it has no handle and no owner then, and is given both when it is added.

member.name: P:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDBObject.Annotative
member.summary: Gets or sets whether the object is annotative, as AutoCAD's Annotative: drawn at the size its scale gives it on the sheet, each scale it is shown at a context of its own ().

value.para: Get, as AutoCAD keeps it: for a TEXT, an MTEXT, an attribute, a dimension, a leader, a multileader, a tolerance, a hatch, a text style, a dimension style and a block, the flag of its extended data AcadAnnotative, the second 1070 of AnnotativeData, where it has none; a multileader is annotative by its own group 293 () as well; an INSERT by its block, that of a dynamic block by the dynamic block where its anonymous block is not; an ATTRIB by its INSERT, whatever its own data says, as AutoCAD 2021 reads it: the attribute ATT_DVSUP of AutoCAD's sample, whose AcadAnnotative says 0, is annotative in its annotative valve, and one of contexts is not in a block that is not (check D35b); in a block that is not annotative, an ATTRIB whose own data says 1 and that holds a context is, as AutoCAD 2021 read the attribute it made of an annotative definition in a block that was not, and one that says 1 and holds none is not (check D35c); a multileader style by its group 296. for every other object, as a line.

Set , a text style or a dimension style is given the extended data AcadAnnotative (1000 AnnotativeData, then 1070 1 and 1070 1 in braces), which is all AutoCAD keeps of it; a multileader style is given 1 in its group 296, and no extended data, as AutoCAD 2021 keeps the flag of the style it makes annotative (0 when set false). Set , the extended data is taken out, with AcadAnnoPO, a multileader's 293 is made 0, and an entity's contexts go with the dictionary AcDbContextDataManager of its extension dictionary, of any kind of entity: its own groups, those of the scale it was last shown at, stay. A value the object has changes nothing. A block set true is given the same data. A TEXT, an MTEXT, an attribute definition, a HATCH or a multileader set true is made annotative as AutoCAD 2021 makes it: its extended data (a multileader its 293 of 1), an extension dictionary with AcDbContextDataManager and ACDB_ANNOTATIONSCALES and in it the default context, *A1, of the scale CANNOSCALE names (1:1 in paper space), its record kept except for a hatch's pattern lines, which are multiplied by 1 over the scale; shows it at others.

member.exception: Thrown when the value set is , or not one of the enumeration.

Thrown when set on an object that is never annotative, as AutoCAD answers eNotApplicable; on an object in no file or erased; true on a style or an entity in a file older than R2007 (AC1021); or true on an entity when the drawing's list has no scale named as CANNOSCALE says.

Thrown when set true on a dimension, a leader, a tolerance or an attribute, which AutoCAD lays out again at each scale (the presenter makes a dimension annotative by laying its picture out itself); set on an INSERT (annotative as its block is); or set false on a block.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDBObject.HasContext(GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfObjectContext)
member.summary: Gets whether the object is shown at a scale, as AutoCAD's HasContext: whether a context under ACDB_ANNOTATIONSCALES of AcDbContextDataManager of its extension dictionary points at the scale's SCALE, by the first 340 of its subclass AcDbAnnotScaleObjectContextData, of any kind of context; never for an object that is never annotative ( ), as a LINE, a CIRCLE or a layer, whatever records it holds, as AutoCAD 2021 answered for eleven kinds of entity handed a TEXT's contexts by (check D37), which keeps them. Those two groups, with the default flag (290 of AcDbObjectContextData), are all the library reads of a context, but for the placing of the context of a TEXT, an attribute or a definition, an MTEXT and an INSERT, which , and read and write; the rest of AutoCAD's record of it is kept as it is. A copy in no file () carries the contexts of its original, and is shown at the scales of its original's drawing.
member.param: The scale, of the object's drawing's list.
member.returns: Whether it is; false for a scale of another drawing or in none, for an object never annotative, and for an object with no contexts, as one not annotative, but for an annotative INSERT, or an ATTRIB of one, that holds none, which is shown at the scale named 1:1, whatever CANNOSCALE says, as AutoCAD 2021 read one (check D35b).
member.exception: Thrown when the scale is null.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDBObject.RemoveContext(GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfObjectContext)
member.summary: Stops showing an annotative object at a scale, as AutoCAD's RemoveContext and its OBJECTSCALE Delete do: its context of the scale erased with its entry of ACDB_ANNOTATIONSCALES, of any kind of object, every other context kept as it is; the picture block of a dimension's context goes with it, and an INSERT's attributes lose the scale too. Where the context is the default, the next in the order of the dictionary becomes it (its 290 of 1) and the record takes that context's data, as AutoCAD 2021 rewrites it: a TEXT of 125 at 1:50 with 1:100 beside it is 250 high once 1:50 is deleted, an MTEXT's width the context's, a HATCH's pattern lines, an INSERT's factors and place, a dimension's block and the middle of its words, and a multileader's context data those of the new default. The entry added after is named as AutoCAD names it within a session, one more than the highest number the dictionary has held: after *A2 was deleted, *A3. A scale the object is not shown at changes nothing.
member.exception: Thrown when the scale is null.

Thrown when the scale is the last the object is shown at, as AutoCAD keeps one (make it not annotative by instead); when the object is erased; or when it is a copy in no file that carries its original's contexts, until it is added to a drawing.

member.summary: The context of a multileader at another scale, laid out as AutoCAD 2021 lays it out (probed on multileaders of an annotative style, text 0.2 high at 1:50 and 1:100): the scale (40) is 1 over the new scale's, the sizes (41 the text height, 140 the arrowhead, 145 the landing gap, 43 and 44 the box, 142 and 143 the columns, and the dogleg's length 40 inside each LEADER{) multiplied by , the old scale's over the new one's; the leaders' lines stay where they are. The dogleg of a leader ends at the content (its landing moved along its direction by its length). A multileader of one leader keeps its landing: the content moves with the dogleg's end, its base (10) and its location (12 for text, 15 for a block) at the old offsets from the old end multiplied by the factor. A multileader of two or more leaders keeps its base, whichever sides they are on (probed with two on one side and with four, two on each side): the text and the ends of the doglegs are at the old offsets from it multiplied by the factor, and each landing is the end moved back by the new length. Text 0.2 high at 1:50 with the landing (100, 100) and a dogleg of 0.36 has at 1:100 the base (100.72, 100) and the text 9.72 right of it, 0.4 high; the same with a second leader on the other side keeps the base at (100.36, 100) and moves the first landing to (99.64, 100), and with two more leaders on each side of "HELLO" the base (168, 150) stays at 1:100 while the landings left of the words go from 150 to 132. A block content has its scale (16) and the diagonal of its matrix (47) multiplied by the factor, its translation as it was.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDBObject.AddContext(GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfObjectContext)
member.summary: Makes the object shown at another scale, as AutoCAD's ObjectContexts.AddContext (the command OBJECTSCALE, Add): a context of the scale is written next to the others under ACDB_ANNOTATIONSCALES of its extension dictionary, named *A and one more than the highest number the object holds, not the default (290 of 0), and made from the default context as AutoCAD 2021 makes it (checked on a TEXT, an MTEXT, an ATTDEF, a HATCH and an INSERT of an annotative block drawn at 1:1 and 1:50): a TEXT and an attribute definition keep their point, angle and mode; an MTEXT keeps its place and direction and has its width, the height of its box and the width and height of its words (40, 41, 42, 43) multiplied by the default's scale over the new one's (an MTEXT 40 wide at 1:1 is 2000 wide at 1:50); a HATCH has the lines of its pattern (43, 44, 45, 46, 49) multiplied so, and 1 over the scale in its group 40 (50 at 1:50), and has its view context written first from its default context as it stands, replaced where it has one (KeepHatchView: a hatch moved by (100, 50) and then given 1:2 holds 43 of 100, 44 of 50 in its view, as -OBJECTSCALE Add writes it); an INSERT has its three factors multiplied so (50 at 1:50 for a 1 at 1:1) and each attribute of it that holds contexts is given one as well, its point moved out from the INSERT's by the same factor: the attribute at (300, 1003) of an INSERT at (300, 1000) is at (300, 1150) at 1:50. An INSERT that holds no context gets the scale as its one context, the default, its record's factors and those of the context multiplied by 1 over the scale, as AutoCAD 2021 gave it. A MULTILEADER holding text is laid out again: its scale (40) is 1 over the new scale's, its sizes (the text height, the arrowhead, the landing gap, the dogleg) multiplied by the default's scale over the new one's, the landing and its lines kept, and the content moved out from the landing by the new dogleg: text 0.2 high at 1:50 is 0.4 at 1:100, a dogleg of 0.36 is 0.72, and the words stand 9.72 right of the landing (check GHAN4). The record of the other kinds is kept: their size at the other scale is worked out from it.
member.param: The scale, of the object's drawing's list.
member.exception: Thrown when the scale is null.
Thrown when the scale is not one of this drawing's list.
Thrown when the object is not annotative (), as AutoCAD answers eNotApplicable; is in no file, is erased, or is a copy in no file that carries its original's contexts.

Thrown for a dimension, whose picture the library does not lay out (the presenter does: a context per scale each with its own block), for a multileader that holds neither words nor a block, and for the other annotative kinds whose contexts the library does not make for a second scale yet.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDBObject.KeepExtensionOf(GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDBObject)
member.summary: Gives a copy of an object, added to the object's own drawing, the data its original keeps in its extension dictionary, as AutoCAD 2021's COPY and MIRROR copy it (probed in its console, mirror-4 GHM4B, GHM4E): a dictionary of its own, owned by the copy, holding every XRECORD of the original's and every DICTIONARY of XRECORDs and dictionaries, each a new object in its place with the same name, groups and order, owned by the dictionary above it. What a copied XRECORD points at (330, 340, 350 and 360 among its data) among the objects copied, the original included, it points at the copy of: a pointer at the original entity names the copy, one at the original's XRECORD its copy. An ownership pointer (350, 360) at an XRECORD, or a dictionary of them, outside the objects copied names a clone of that object, owned by the copied XRECORD (mirror-5 GHM5GPTR); a pointer at any other object stays. The entries stand in the copy's dictionary ordered by name, as AutoCAD keeps them. An original with an empty dictionary gives its copy an empty one; one whose dictionary holds only entries of another kind (contexts, a clip, a representation, fields), which other code copies, gives none here. Entries the copy has already are left as they are.
member.param: The object copied, in the same drawing.

member.name: P:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDBObject.XData
member.summary: Gets or sets the extended data of the object, as AutoCAD's XData does: each application's data opened by its name in a group 1001, then its groups 1000 to 1071, as the file writes them.

value.para: Get, every application's data in the order of the record, empty where it has none, a new list on each call. The texts of an application's name (1001), a string (1000) and a layer's name (1003) have their escapes read as letters, as a layer's name has: a letter the file's code page has not, written as \U+0110, comes back as the letter it was set as.

Set, as AutoCAD sets it: each application named in the groups given has its data replaced by what follows its 1001, and an application given with nothing after its 1001 has its data taken out; the data of the applications not named is kept. new[] { new DxfTypedValue(1001, "GHPROBE"), new DxfTypedValue(1000, "B-12"), new DxfTypedValue(1040, "2.5") } gives the application GHPROBE a text and a real. An application the file's table of applications does not list is added to it, as AutoCAD registers one. Data the same as the object has changes nothing.

member.exception: Thrown when the groups set are null.
Thrown when the groups set do not begin with a 1001, have a code outside 1000 to 1071, or name an application with no name.
Thrown when the object is erased, or is model or paper space of a file that has no record of it, as one of R12 with no block of it.

member.exception: Thrown when the object is in no file, or is erased.
Thrown for an object not erased yet: a table, a dictionary, a layout.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDBObject.SetFromStyle
member.summary: Takes away what the object holds of its own over its style, as AutoCAD's SetFromStyle, so that it is drawn as its style draws it: a dimension and a leader lose their overrides of the dimension style (the list DSTYLE of their extended data of ACAD), a of Dimasz 4.5 of its own over a style of 3.5 reading 3.5 again; a takes the values of its multileader style, as its own says; a loses its own overrides and its cells', as its own says. An object of no style changes nothing.
member.returns: Whether the object has a style it is set from, as AutoCAD answers: true for a table, and for a dimension, a leader and a multileader of a style its drawing has (for a copy in no file, the drawing it was copied from); false, and nothing changed, for one of a style its drawing has not, or in no drawing, and for every other object.
member.exception: Thrown when the object has overrides to take away and is erased.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDBObject.HandOverTo(GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDBObject,System.Boolean,System.Boolean)
member.summary: Puts an object made in code in this one's place in the drawing, as AutoCAD's HandOverTo hands an object's id over: the new object's records written where this one's stand, in its block and at its place among the block's entities, with this one's handle, owner and reactors, so that what pointed at this one points at the new one; this one is in no file from then on, a copy of what it was with no handle and no owner, to be appended again or let go.

remarks.para: A LINE handed over to a new DxfCircle(centre, normal, 5) on the layer holes is that circle under the LINE's handle: a GROUP that held the line holds the circle, and the circle is on holes in its own colour, as made. The new object is written as writes one, its layer added to the table where the table has none of it and what it brings from another drawing copied with it; a record that follows it, as a VERTEX, is given a handle of its own and owned by the handle it takes. The records that followed this one, as the vertices of a POLYLINE, go, their handles not given again.

A copy of an annotative entity that carries its original's contexts () is given them as gives them, where this one's extension dictionary is not kept; kept, that dictionary stands for the copy's, its contexts those this one had, or none, as AutoCAD 2021 writes it: a LINE handed over to the copy of a TEXT shown at (11, 12) at 1:1 beside its default of 1:2 at (40, 12) is that TEXT shown at (11, 12) at both, its dictionary not kept, and at (40, 12) at none, kept (check D35d). Kept, the extended data of this one replaces the new object's where this one has some; where it has none, the new object keeps its own, its AcadAnnotative among it, as AutoCAD 2021 keeps it.

Kept, the dictionary's contexts are not converted, as AutoCAD 2021 converts none, and those of another kind of entity are refused: AutoCAD crashed reading its own drawings of a TEXT handed over to an MTEXT, an MTEXT to a TEXT, an INSERT to a TEXT and a TEXT to an INSERT, each keeping its dictionary (check D35e). A TEXT, an ATTDEF and an ATTRIB take one another's contexts, which AutoCAD read; an MTEXT and an INSERT their own; an entity never annotative, as a LINE, any; a dimension, a leader, a multileader, a tolerance and a hatch those of their own class alone.
Entities alone hand their place over: a record of a table, a dictionary and the other objects of the OBJECTS section are refused, as is a VERTEX or an ATTRIB, which belongs to the entity it follows.

member.param: The object to take the place: an entity made in code, or copied, and in no file.
Whether the new object takes this one's extended data, which then replaces its own where this one has some; false keeps the new object's own.
Whether the new object takes this one's extension dictionary; false takes the dictionary out of the drawing, with what it holds.
member.exception: Thrown when the new object is null.

Thrown when the new object is this one, is in a file already or erased, or is one this drawing's version cannot hold, as refuses it; or when the extension dictionary is kept and holds contexts of a kind the new object does not take, as a TEXT's handed over to an MTEXT; nothing is written then.
Thrown when this object is in no file, or is erased.
Thrown when either object is not an entity, or this one follows another.

member.name: T:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDimStyleTableRecord
member.summary: A dimension style of a DXF file, as AutoCAD's DimStyleTableRecord, read from its DIMSTYLE record: its name and its dimension variables, each by its group, by 41, by 140.

remarks.para: The style ISO-25 has arrowheads 2.5 long (), texts 2.5 high () set 0.625 off the dimension line () and two decimal places (); a variable its record gives no group for reads as AutoCAD's own, that of its template acad.dwt: arrowheads 0.18 long, texts 0.18 high, four decimal places. Values are as AutoCAD's .NET gives them: an angle in radians (; the file writes degrees), a colour as a , an arrowhead as the block it is drawn with, null for AutoCAD's closed filled one.

A style of a file is changed by its setters, its record written anew, every other group kept; a setter given the value its getter gives changes nothing. A variable a file's version has not, as (R2000) in one of R12, is refused there with an . Each points at a block, a linetype or a text style by its handle from R2000 on (340 to 347), and at an arrowhead's block by its name (5, 6 and 7) in a file of R12.

A style made in code holds AutoCAD's own values until it is given others, and is written whole, every variable its file's version has, when it is added to a ; its handle written as group 105, as AutoCAD writes a DIMSTYLE's. Renamed, the dimensions, leaders and tolerances drawn in it, the styles AutoCAD keeps for each kind of dimension of it (GH$0, GH$2 of GH) and the header's $DIMSTYLE follow.

member.name: T:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfField
member.summary: A field of a DXF file, as AutoCAD's Field: a FIELD of the OBJECTS section, the code AutoCAD evaluates to the words a text shows, kept in the extension dictionary of the object it belongs to, in its dictionary ACAD_FIELD, and reached by .

remarks.para: A text with fields in it holds a text field, of the evaluator _text, whose code is the text with each field standing as %<\_FldIdx 0>%, %<\_FldIdx 1>% and on, the fields its children in that order (90 and 360). The TEXT that reads Drawn 27/10/2026, the date a field, has the text field of the code Drawn %<\_FldIdx 0>% and one child, of the evaluator AcVar and the code \AcVar Date \f "dd/MM/yyyy", and its gives Drawn %<\AcVar Date \f "dd/MM/yyyy">%.

The library does not evaluate a field: the words of the text are those AutoCAD wrote when it last evaluated it, and the value it kept. A field made in code, new DxfField("Drawn %<\\AcVar Date>%", true), and given to a text by , is written in the groups the DXF reference gives a FIELD, marked not evaluated (95 of 1) and to be evaluated whenever AutoCAD evaluates its fields (91 of 63), the text keeping its words until then. That layout has not been read by AutoCAD itself yet: the state (94 of 0), the empty value's flag (93 of 1) and, before R2007, the format (group 4 between 331 and 91, which libredwg reads in a DWG of that version and the library does not write) are the library's reading of the reference and of libredwg, to be checked on a drawing AutoCAD saved.

member.name: T:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfGeoData
member.summary: A GEODATA of a DXF file, as AutoCAD's GeoLocationData: where a drawing stands on the earth, kept in the extension dictionary of its block, model space's, under the name ACAD_GEOGRAPHICDATA; its design point and the reference point of the coordinate system it stands for, the units and scales that take the drawing's units to metres, the up and north directions, the coordinate system itself and the points of the mesh that fit the one to the other, read and set as the groups of AcDbGeoData of the DXF reference.

remarks.para: new DxfGeoData { BlockTableRecord = db.ModelSpace, TypeOfCoordinates = DxfTypeOfCoordinates.Local, DesignPoint = new GeoPoint3(0, 0, 0), ReferencePoint = new GeoPoint3(500000, 4100000, 0), HorizontalUnits = DxfUnits.Millimeters, HorizontalUnitsScale = 0.001 }.PostToDb() places a drawing in millimetres on a local grid, its origin at 500 000 east and 4 100 000 north: a GEODATA at the end of the OBJECTS section owned by model space's extension dictionary, made where it had none, and the class GEODATA listed where the drawing lists none. reads it back.

A GEODATA made in code is AutoCAD 2021's new one, written in the order of ezdxf's: of version 3, as AutoCAD 2021 writes one (group 90), of no known type of coordinates, its two points at the origin, its units metres of scale 1, up along Z and north along Y, its scale judged at the reference point, a coordinate system of no text and no mesh. It is posted to model space alone, as AutoCAD's BlockTableRecordId takes no other block. A GEODATA came with R2010 (AC1024), version 1 of R2009 having no DXF version of its own: one of version 1 is read by the groups a comment of ezdxf gives it, those of version 2 but the north direction, the points of its mesh in 12 and 13 there; ezdxf 1.4.5 itself reads no points of the mesh in one of version 1, and only warns of it.

The faces of the mesh (96 to 99) are kept as they are and not given. Taking a point to latitude and longitude, AutoCAD's TransformToLonLatAlt and TransformFromLonLatAlt, needs the coordinate system's projection, which AutoCAD works out by its own library: neither is here.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfGeoData.PostToDb
member.summary: Adds the GEODATA made in code to the drawing of its , as AutoCAD's PostToDb: at the end of the OBJECTS section, owned by the block's extension dictionary, which is made where the block has none, under the name ACAD_GEOGRAPHICDATA, the GEODATA it held erased, as ezdxf replaces it; the block's handle written as its group 330 and the class GEODATA listed where the drawing lists none, as AutoCAD 2021 lists it (flags 4095, a count of 1).

member.name: T:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfGroup
member.summary: A GROUP of a DXF file, as AutoCAD's Group: a named list of entities of the drawing, picked together where it is selectable, kept in the group dictionary (, ACAD_GROUP) under its name.

remarks.para: db.GroupDictionary.SetAt("BEAMS", new DxfGroup("Beams of grid A", true)) adds the group BEAMS, and group.Append(beam) puts an entity in it: the entity's handle is written last among the group's (340), and the group's handle into the entity's list of reactors (330 in {ACAD_REACTORS), as AutoCAD writes a member. Taken out, the entity leaves the list and the group its reactors.

The members are the entities the group lists that the drawing has: an entity erased leaves the group at once, as it leaves AutoCAD's, and the file saved lists it no longer. A group left empty is kept, named or anonymous, as AutoCAD 2021 keeps it whatever emptied it: its last member erased, , , or never given one; the groups G_ERASE, G_REMOVE and G_NEW_EMPTY so emptied, and the anonymous *A1, *A2 and *A3, are all in the drawing it saves, each of no member.
The look of every member is set at once by , and the others: a group of a line and a circle given the colour 1 has both red.

member.summary: The hyperlinks of an entity or a block, as AutoCAD's HyperLinkCollection: read from the extended data of the application PE_URL of its object each time they are asked for, and written back into it by every change.

remarks.para: line.Hyperlinks.Add(new DxfHyperLink { Name = "https://example.com/B-12.pdf", Description = "Plate B-12" }) gives the line the extended data 1001 PE_URL, 1000 https://example.com/B-12.pdf, 1002 {, 1000 Plate B-12, 1002 }, as AutoCAD and ezdxf write it, and the table of applications the application PE_URL where it lacks it. The last hyperlink taken out takes the application's data with it.

A hyperlink read from the collection is a copy: one changed is written by setting it back, links[0] = link. The extended data a file gives in braces beyond the description and the sub-location, as AutoCAD's own flags, is read past and not written again.

member.name: T:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfLayerFilter
member.summary: A layer filter of a drawing, as AutoCAD's LayerFilter: its name, the filter it is nested in and those nested in it; read, not changed.

remarks.para: The root, All, is made by AutoCAD, not kept in the drawing: it is not deleted or renamed. Nested in it are the named filters the drawing keeps, as AutoCAD 2021 lists them: first those of the dictionary ACLYDICTIONARY of the layer table's extension dictionary, where AutoCAD 2005 and later keep property filters and groups, each an XRECORD named by its group 300, in the order of the dictionary; then those of ACAD_LAYERFILTERS, the dictionary of AutoCAD 2004 and earlier, named by their entries, where ACLYDICTIONARY has none of the name (AutoCAD keeps a property filter in both); last the three AutoCAD makes, All Used Layers, Unreconciled New Layers and Viewport Overrides. A drawing with the property filter GH_STEEL and the group GH_NOTES gives those two, then the three.

What a filter lets through (AutoCAD's FilterExpression, group 301 of a property filter's XRECORD), the layers of a group (its 330s), the filters nested deeper and the filter that is current are not read, and a filter is not added, changed or deleted here.

member.name: T:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfLayerStateManager
member.summary: The layer states of a drawing, as AutoCAD's LayerStateManager lists them: the XRECORDs of the dictionary ACAD_LAYERSTATES in the extension dictionary of the layer table, one for each state, named by its entry. Reached by .

remarks.para: A drawing AutoCAD saved with the states Plan and Sections gives GetLayerStateNames() as Plan and Sections, and HasLayerState("plan") true, letters of either case the same as AutoCAD finds a state; each state's record is LayerStatesDictionary.GetAt("Plan"), a whose are its groups as the file holds them.

The states are read and listed, not saved, restored, renamed or taken apart. AutoCAD 2021 writes a state's XRECORD as its mask (91), its description (301), 290 and 302, then each layer: its handle (330), or its name (8) for a state of an xref or one imported from a .las file, then its flags (90), colour (62), lineweight (370), linetype (331) and plot style (1), and 440; the mask's flag 0x8000 marks a state hidden. Only the names and those two marks are read here: AutoCAD's SaveLayerState, RestoreLayerState, RenameLayerState, DeleteLayerState, GetLayerStateLayers, GetLayerStateMask and GetLayerStateDescription are not here.

member.summary: A layer of a DXF file, as AutoCAD's LayerTableRecord: its name, the colour, linetype and lineweight its entities take where they say BYLAYER, and whether it is off, frozen, locked and plotted.

remarks.para: A layer of the file is read from its LAYER record and changed by its setters, its record written anew, every other group kept as it was; a setter given the value its getter gives changes nothing. The layer steel in red, turned off, is written as the colour -1: it is 1 and true.

A layer of a file is renamed by its , every reference to it with it, and erased by where nothing is drawn on it: the layer steel renamed Steel_S355 has every entity of it, in model space, paper space and the blocks, its vertices and attributes among them, on Steel_S355, and $CLAYER too where it was the current layer.

member.name: T:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfLayout
member.summary: A layout of a DXF file, as AutoCAD's Layout: a tab of the drawing, Model or a sheet of paper space, with its name, its place among the tabs, its limits and extents, the block that holds its entities and its viewports, and the settings it is plotted with ().

remarks.para: The layouts are , in the order of their tabs, and the entries of , by name. A drawing ezdxf made has Model and Layout1: Layout1's is *Paper_Space, its limits (0, 0) to (420, 297), a sheet of A3 on its side.

A layout is read; its name is set, the entry of the layout dictionary renamed with it. One made in code is added as AutoCAD's is, var plan = new DxfLayout { LayoutName = "Plan 1-50" }; plan.AddToLayoutDictionary(db, null); plan.Initialize();: its LAYOUT, its block and its entry by , the viewport that shows its sheet by . Its sheet is set as AutoCAD's PlotSettingsValidator sets it, once it is added: plan.CanonicalMediaName = "ISO_A2_(594.00_x_420.00_MM)" puts it on a sheet of A2 on its side, 594 by 420, its limits made (-7.5, -20) to (586.5, 400) with them; what is plotted, its scale, plot style table and flags are set as says, and the rest of the plot settings are read, not set.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfLayout.AddToLayoutDictionary(GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDatabase,GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfBlockTableRecord)
member.summary: Adds a layout made in code to a drawing, as AutoCAD's AddToLayoutDictionary: a LAYOUT at the end of the OBJECTS section, named in the layout dictionary (ACAD_LAYOUT) by its , on the tab after the last, with the plot settings of a sheet of A3 on its side and no plotter; and the block that holds its entities, whose BLOCK_RECORD names the layout (group 340), made where none is given. The layout has no viewport until gives it one.

remarks.para: A drawing ezdxf made with Model, Layout1 and Sheet A on tab 3, its block *Paper_Space0, is given new DxfLayout { LayoutName = "Plan 1-50" } on tab 4 with the block *Paper_Space1, the first of *Paper_Space0, *Paper_Space1 and on the drawing has not, as AutoCAD and ezdxf name it.

The plot settings are ezdxf's for a new layout, named as AutoCAD names no plotter and its sheet of ISO A3: no page setup, the device none_device, the sheet ISO_A3_(420.00_x_297.00_MM) 420 by 297 in millimetres, margins 7.5 at the sides and 20 above and below, plotted as a layout at 1:1 (flags 688: viewports first, lineweights, plot styles, the standard scale), shaded as displayed at the normal level of 300 dots an inch. The limits are the sheet about the corner of its plotted area, (-7.5, -20) to (412.5, 277), its extents empty, its user coordinate system the world's, and its flags 1 (PSLTSCALE), as ezdxf's layouts have them. Another sheet is set once the layout is added, before sizes its viewport 1 by the limits: plan.CanonicalMediaName = "ISO_A1_(841.00_x_594.00_MM)" for A1 on its side.

Each layout added costs a little more the more the drawing has, its dictionary and block table written anew: 200 layouts added and initialized in one drawing take 0.14 to 0.25 s once the code is compiled, and 0.35 to 0.56 s as the first work of a process; AutoCAD allows 255.

member.param: The drawing, of R2000 or later.

The block of the layout: one of the drawing's named *Paper_Space and a number, as AutoCAD names those of its layouts, that no layout has, its BLOCK_RECORD naming none (340 of 0, or no 340); null to have one made.
member.exception: Thrown when the drawing is null.
Thrown when the drawing has a layout of the name already, letters of either case the same, or the block given is not one of the drawing's named *Paper_Space and a number, or is a layout's.
Thrown when the layout is in a drawing already, or has no name, or the drawing has no layout dictionary, as one older than R2000 (AC1015) has none.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfLayout.Initialize
member.summary: Gives a layout of paper space the viewport that shows its sheet, as AutoCAD's Initialize: a VIEWPORT of 1 in its block ahead of the viewports it has, on and stacked first (68 of 1), about the middle of its and 1.1 times their size, showing the sheet at 1:1, as ezdxf makes the main viewport of a layout; the layout's last active viewport (group 331) where it names none. A layout that has its viewport 1 is given nothing.
member.remarks: A layout added as adds one, of limits (-7.5, -20) to (412.5, 277), is given a viewport about (202.5, 128.5) 462 by 326.7, its view about the same point 326.7 high. Limits of no area are taken as the sheet from (0, 0) to its . The first VIEWPORT of a layout is the one AutoCAD and BricsCAD take for its sheet: a layout that has viewports and no viewport 1, as Layout1 given one 50 by 40 turned on, has them moved after the new one, their handles kept, and those stacked on (68 of 1 or more) moved up one, the 50 by 40 from 1 to 2. A viewport 1 keeps its size when the sheet is set after it is made, as AutoCAD draws it anew when it next shows the layout: a sheet is best set before.

member.summary: A linetype of a DXF file, as AutoCAD's LinetypeTableRecord: its name, its description, the length of its pattern and its dashes, a dash above nought drawn, below nought a gap, nought a dot; a dash of a complex linetype carries a shape or a text, drawn in a style at a scale, a rotation and an offset of its own.

remarks.para: A linetype of a file is read from its LTYPE record; its , , and each dash's length, shape or text are set as any record's are, its record written anew and every other group kept; how many dashes it has is not changed yet. One made in code is given its dashes by and , and is written when it is added to a ; its pattern is as long as its dashes and gaps together unless it is given a length.

The gas line of AutoCAD's acadiso.lin, a dash 0.5 long, then the text GAS in the style Standard, 0.1 high, 0.1 back and 0.05 down, in a gap of 0.2, is SetTextAt(1, "GAS"), SetShapeStyleAt(1, standard), SetShapeScaleAt(1, 0.1) and SetShapeOffsetAt(1, new GeoVector2(-0.1, -0.05)) on its second dash, written as AutoCAD writes it: 49 -0.2, 74 2, 75 0, 340 the handle of Standard, 46 0.1, 50 0.0, 44 -0.1, 45 -0.05, 9 GAS. A dash given a shape or a text and no scale is drawn at the scale 1. A file of R12 has no complex linetypes, which came with R13 (AC1012), and refuses them.

remarks.para: The style Standard of a drawing of ezdxf has words 4 high in its text style Standard, arrows 4 long, a landing gap of 2 and doglegs 8 long, its leaders straight and BYBLOCK, the words met on the left and right at the middle of their top line; a group the record leaves out reads as that style has it.

A style in no file, made by new DxfMLeaderStyle() as AutoCAD's new MLeaderStyle() is made, has the values of that style Standard, and is added to a drawing by of its dictionary of multileader styles: db.MLeaderStyleDictionary.SetAt("GH_NOTES", style) writes every group AutoCAD 2021 holds of one, in its order, a linetype, an arrow block, a text style or a block the drawing has none of left out. It can be given instead the values a multileader is drawn with by : its style's, and those the multileader overrides its own; its blocks are then those of the multileader's drawing.

Each value set is written into the record at once, as AutoCAD 2021 holds it (checked by entget): the angles a leader's segments are kept to in radians, 45 degrees as 0.785398; no limit to the points of a leader as 0; a style scaled to the layout as a scale of 0. member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfObjectContextCollection.AddContext(GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfObjectContext)
member.summary: Adds a scale made in code to the list, as AutoCAD's AddContext: a SCALE at the end of the OBJECTS section, owned by ACAD_SCALELIST and named in it as AutoCAD 2021 names one, *A and one more than the highest number of such a name the list has or was given while the drawing is open: Z1, Z2 and Z3 added are *A1, *A2 and *A3, and Z4 added once Z3 is taken out is *A4 (check D35e). Its name (300), units (140, 141) and the flag of the unit scale (290) are written as AutoCAD writes them, the flag 1 for a scale of as many units of the paper as of the drawing, 1:1, where the list has no unit scale, as AutoCAD keeps one, else 0; the class SCALE listed in the CLASSES section where it is not. The dictionary ACAD_SCALELIST is added to the named object dictionary where it has none, in a file of R2007 (AC1021) or later, the version of AutoCAD 2008, which brought the list. The scale stands for its SCALE from then on.
member.param: The scale, a made in code and in no file.
member.exception: Thrown when the scale is null.
Thrown when the context is not a , is in a file already, has no name, or has the name of a scale of the list, as AutoCAD answers eDuplicateKey.
Thrown when the drawing has no OBJECTS section, or has no ACAD_SCALELIST and is older than R2007, or holds an ACAD_SCALELIST that is not a dictionary.

member.name: T:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfPlotSettings
member.summary: The settings a layout is plotted with, as AutoCAD's PlotSettings: the part AcDbPlotSettings of a LAYOUT, and a PLOTSETTINGS of the page setups (); read as the file holds them.
member.remarks: The sizes of the sheet are in millimetres whatever says, as AutoCAD writes them: a sheet of A3 laid on its side is 420 by 297, its margins 7.5 at the sides and 20 above and below in a drawing ezdxf made. What a sheet needs is set as AutoCAD's PlotSettingsValidator sets it: its name and with it its size (), its , , and ; a layout set to ISO_A2_(594.00_x_420.00_MM) lies on a sheet 594 by 420. What is plotted and how is set as the validator and AutoCAD's PlotSettings set it too: the plotter's name (), the plot style table, and the window, the scale standard or custom, and the flags of centring, plot styles and lineweights; a page setup of A3 at 1:20 with monochrome.ctb is read back as written. The rest is read and not written: a change to it is AutoCAD's plotting to see to.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfPlotSettings.#ctor

They are those of a layout made in code, a sheet of ISO A3, until they are set or copied into ().

member.value: Set, the group written as it is; the name it has changes nothing, and the entry that names a page setup is not renamed.
member.exception: Thrown when the name set is null.

member.value: Set, as AutoCAD's PlotSettingsValidator.SetPlotConfigurationName sets the device, to any name, written as group 2: none_device for no plotter, as AutoCAD writes it. The sheet is set apart, by . The name it has changes nothing.
member.exception: Thrown when the name set is null.
Thrown when the settings are in no drawing, as a layout made in code before it is added, or are erased.

member.name: P:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfPlotSettings.CanonicalMediaName
member.summary: Gets or sets the name of the sheet as the plotter calls it (group 4), as AutoCAD's CanonicalMediaName, such as ISO_full_bleed_A3_(420.00_x_297.00_MM); empty where it has none.
member.value: Set, as AutoCAD's PlotSettingsValidator.SetCanonicalMediaName sets it, to a name that ends in the size of the sheet in millimetres, width then height, as AutoCAD names the sheets of no plotter: the ISO sheets ISO_A0_(1189.00_x_841.00_MM), ISO_A1_(841.00_x_594.00_MM), ISO_A2_(594.00_x_420.00_MM), ISO_A3_(420.00_x_297.00_MM) and ISO_A4_(297.00_x_210.00_MM) on their sides, and ISO_A0_(841.00_x_1189.00_MM) to ISO_A4_(210.00_x_297.00_MM) upright; a sheet of a size of its own as ezdxf's page_setup names one, ezdxf_(1000.00_x_500.00_MM). The name is written as group 4 and its size as (44 and 45): a layout set to ISO_A2_(594.00_x_420.00_MM) has a sheet 594 by 420. The margins, the plot's origin and its turn are kept, and a layout's made the sheet about its plotted area again. The name it has changes nothing.
member.exception: Thrown when the name set is null.
Thrown when the name set does not end in a size in millimetres above nought, as _(594.00_x_420.00_MM), after letters, digits, _, . and -; or the margins leave no room on a sheet of that size.
Thrown when the settings are in no drawing, as a layout made in code before it is added, or are erased.

member.exception: Thrown when the name set is null.
Thrown when the settings are in no drawing, as a layout made in code before it is added, or are erased.

member.summary: Gets or sets the margins of the sheet, as AutoCAD's PlotPaperMargins: its the left (group 40) and bottom (41) margins, its the right (42) and top (43), in millimetres.
member.value: Set, the four written in millimetres whatever says, and a layout's made the sheet about its plotted area again: a layout of A2 on its side given margins of 10 all round has limits (-10, -10) to (584, 410). AutoCAD takes its margins from the plotter's sheet, which a DXF does not hold; a reader that has no plotter, as ezdxf and the library, takes these. The margins it has change nothing.

member.name: T:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfRasterImageDef
member.summary: An IMAGEDEF of a DXF file, as AutoCAD's RasterImageDef: the picture file the IMAGEs of a drawing show, under its name in the dictionary of images (), with the size in pixels and the size of a pixel AutoCAD read from the file when it loaded it.

remarks.para: The library reads no picture: what AutoCAD learns by loading the file (its colours, its kind, whether it is found) it has not, and the path is kept as the file writes it. A PNG of 4 by 3 pixels at 96 dots an inch, loaded by AutoCAD 2021, is an IMAGEDEF of the size (4, 3) and pixels of 0.2646 mm, its resolution in centimetres.

Made in code, a definition is given its path and its size in pixels, which AutoCAD reads from the file and the library cannot, and added to a drawing's dictionary of images under a name: DxfDBDictionary images = DxfRasterImageDef.CreateImageDictionary(db); images.SetAt(DxfRasterImageDef.SuggestName(images, path), new DxfRasterImageDef(path, new GeoVector2(4, 3))); An image is then made of it by .

Added to a drawing by of its dictionary of images ().
member.param: The path of the picture, as it is to be written: C:\pictures\px43.png. AutoCAD 2021 refuses a path it does not find (eFileAccessErr); the library writes it as given.

member.name: T:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfSpatialFilter
member.summary: The clip boundary of a block reference or an external reference, as AutoCAD's XCLIP keeps it: a SPATIAL_FILTER in the dictionary ACAD_FILTER of the reference's extension dictionary, under the name SPATIAL. Reached by ; made by .

remarks.para: The boundary is a list of points in the clip coordinate system, the user coordinate system that was current when it was made: two points are a rectangle's opposite corners, three or more a polygon. carries a point of the world into that system, and a point of the world into the block's own coordinates, measured from its origin, as the reference stood when it was clipped. Both are kept with the boundary, and the reference moved, turned or scaled afterwards leaves them as they are, so that the clip goes with the content: a block 100 by 100 inserted at (1000, 500) and clipped to the rectangle (1020, 520) to (1100, 600) still shows its corner 20 by 20 in from its lower left, in whatever place it is moved to.

A clip turned inside out (XCLIP Invert) is kept as AutoCAD keeps it: a polygon that goes round the outside of the block and in along a slit to the boundary and round that, so that what the polygon holds is the part cut away.

member.name: T:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfSun
member.summary: A SUN of a DXF file, as AutoCAD's Sun: the light of the sun a viewport is lit by, owned by the viewport, which names it (group 361 of the VIEWPORT); whether it is on, its colour and intensity, the day and time it shines at and the shadows it casts, read and set as the groups of AcDbSun of the DXF reference.

remarks.para: viewport.SetSun(new DxfSun { DateTime = new DateTime(2026, 6, 21, 15, 0, 0), Intensity = 1.5 }) lights a viewport by the sun of a summer afternoon, half as bright again as AutoCAD's: a SUN at the end of the OBJECTS section, owned by the viewport, the day written as its Julian day 2461213 (91) and the time as 54 000 seconds past midnight (92). A sun made in code is ezdxf's new sun: on, white, of intensity 1, casting shadows traced along the rays, on 21 September 2014 at noon; that AutoCAD's own new sun is the same is not confirmed.

A SUN came with R2007 (AC1021). Where the sun stands in the sky, AutoCAD's Altitude, Azimuth and SunDirection, AutoCAD works out from the drawing's geographic location and the day, and the sky (SkyParameters) is its renderer's: a SUN keeps neither, and neither is here.

member.name: T:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfTableStyle
member.summary: The cell styles of a table style beyond the title, the header and the data: the ones a user makes with Create New Cell Style, which AutoCAD 2021 keeps in the table style's CELLSTYLEMAP (under the entry ACAD_ROUNDTRIP_2008_TABLESTYLE_CELLSTYLEMAP of its extension dictionary), each with the table format it was made of, its id (101 on) and its name; and the cell style a cell takes, the id in its TABLECONTENT.

A table style of a DXF file, as AutoCAD's TableStyle: a TABLESTYLE of the dictionary ACAD_TABLESTYLE (), the look a of the style takes where it and its cells give none of their own: the margins of a cell, whether the title and the header are shown, and for each kind of row, the title, the header and the data, its text style, text height, alignment, colours, fill and grid lines.

remarks.para: The record holds its own groups after 100 AcDbTableStyle, then the cells of the data, the title and the header in that order, each opening with its text style (7): its height (140), alignment (170), text colour (62), fill colour (63) and whether the fill is on (283), from R2007 on the kind of its value (90, 91, 1), then for each of its six lines, top, inside and bottom across and left, inside and right down, its lineweight (274 to 279), whether it is drawn (284 to 289) and its colour (64 to 69). A group the record leaves out reads as AutoCAD's Standard has it: the data top centre and the rest middle centre, the text by block in the style Standard, no fill, every line drawn by block. The heights of AutoCAD's Standard are those of the drawing's units: the title 6 and the header and the data 4.5 high, margins of 1.5, in a drawing of millimetres, and 0.25, 0.18 and 0.06 in one of inches.

A style made by new DxfTableStyle() has the values of AutoCAD's Standard in millimetres, and is added to a drawing by of its dictionary of table styles: db.TableStyleDictionary.SetAt("GH_SCHEDULE", style). The record written is the form AutoCAD reads from R2000 on, with no map of cell styles: the title, the header and the data are its three cell styles.

member.name: T:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfTextStyleTableRecord
member.summary: A text style of a DXF file, as AutoCAD's TextStyleTableRecord, read from its STYLE record: its name, its font, its height, width and slant.

remarks.para: The style ROMANS of the font romans.shx, 2.5 high, three quarters wide and slanted 15 degrees is FileName romans.shx, 2.5, 0.75 and 0.2618 radians.

A style of a file is changed by its setters, its record written anew, every other group kept; a setter given the value its getter gives changes nothing. A style made in code is of the font txt, its texts of no fixed height, as wide as high and upright until it is given others, and is written when it is added to a .

Renamed, the texts, MTEXTs, attributes and tables written in it and the header's $TEXTSTYLE follow; Standard is renamed as any other, as AutoCAD 2021's -RENAME renames it. Erased, as AutoCAD's Text Style dialog deletes one, only where nothing is written in it and it is neither Standard nor current.

member.name: T:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfTransparency
member.summary: How much an entity or a layer lets show through it, as AutoCAD's Autodesk.AutoCAD.Colors.Transparency: by layer, by block, or an alpha from 0, clear, to 255, solid. An entity writes it as its group 440, a layer in its extended data of the application AcCmTransparency, both as AutoCAD writes them, from R2004 (AC1018) on.

remarks.para: AutoCAD's 50 per cent is the alpha 127, new DxfTransparency(127), written as 33 554 559 (0x0200007F); BYBLOCK is written as 16 777 216 (0x01000000), and BYLAYER as no group at all. A transparency of nought is the default value of the structure, BYLAYER.
Two transparencies are equal where their methods are and, by alpha, their alphas are.

member.name: T:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfTypedValue
member.summary: One group of a DXF file as it stands in the file, as AutoCAD's TypedValue is one value of extended data or of a result buffer: its code, and its value as the text printed on the line after it.

remarks.para: The value is the line as it is, its spaces kept and nothing read into it: the real of group 10 is its digits, as "4.8721540113315704", and the handle of group 5 its hexadecimal, as "1A3". Where AutoCAD's TypedValue holds a number as a number, this one holds the text a file writes, so that what is read is written back to the byte.
new DxfTypedValue(1000, "B-12") is a text of extended data, and new DxfTypedValue(70, "4") the group of the header that says a drawing is in millimetres.

The value as it is to be written; a number in the digits it is to be written with.
member.exception: Thrown when the value is null.
Thrown when the code is not one of DXF's.

member.name: T:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfXrecord
member.summary: An XRECORD of a DXF file, as AutoCAD's Xrecord: a list of groups an application keeps under a name of a , read and written as the file holds them.

remarks.para: Its is what AutoCAD gives as a ResultBuffer: the groups after its subclass marker and its cloning flag (280), each a code and the text the file prints, new DxfTypedValue(1, "B-12") a text and new DxfTypedValue(40, "2.5") a real. Made in code and added to a dictionary, db.NamedObjectsDictionary.SetAt("GH_PLATE", new DxfXrecord { Data = new[] { new DxfTypedValue(1, "B-12"), new DxfTypedValue(40, "12.5") } }) writes an XRECORD of two groups owned by the named object dictionary, as AutoCAD writes one.

The groups 102 of the data are the data's own: the overrides AutoCAD keeps for a layer in a viewport are XRECORDs of groups such as 102 {ADSK_LYR_COLOR_OVERRIDE, 335 the viewport, 420 the colour, 102 }.

member.value: Set, the groups in the place of those it has, each one the same as the one in its place keeping its bytes; data the same as it has changes nothing. A text of letters the file's code page has not is written with their escapes.
member.exception: Thrown when the groups set are null.
Thrown when a group set is of a code an XRECORD does not hold: 0, 5, 100, 105, 999 and the codes of extended data, 1000 on; or the groups 102 set do not open and close in pairs.

member.name: T:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfBlockConstraints
member.summary: The geometric and dimensional constraints of a block, as AutoCAD keeps them in the associative network of its BLOCK_RECORD (ACAD_ASSOCNETWORK of its extension dictionary): the constraint groups (ACDBASSOC2DCONSTRAINTGROUP), each a list of nodes, the geometry (bounded lines, arcs, circles, datum lines and the implicit points of their ends, middles and centres, each line, arc or circle tied by an ACDBASSOCGEOMDEPENDENCY to a LINE, an ARC, a CIRCLE or an edge of an LWPOLYLINE of the block) and the constraints between them; and the variables (ACDBASSOCVARIABLE) the dimensional constraints read their values from, some worked out from expressions of others. Solved at new values of variables by Newton's method from the block's own geometry, as AutoCAD 2021 solved its Dynamic Blocks samples once AssocManager.EvaluateTopLevelNetwork ran (plugin D27): its Fluorescent, Window and Channel to 1E-12 at 18 values set. Geometry the constraints leave free keeps the base point of each constraint parameter set where it is along its distance, as AutoCAD 2021 kept the left side of its Door Elevation at a new Width where the least change would move both sides; what is still free is held where the block has it, the radii and the arcs' ends first where all at once cannot be met, as it kept the fillets of its Hex Head Bolt whole (plugin D27b). A group of R2018 (AC1032) is read as one of R2010, and a copy of the network is written into an anonymous block standing for the block (DxfBlockConstraints.Network).

The copy of a block's associative network that an anonymous block standing for it holds, as AutoCAD 2021 writes one into the anonymous block of an INSERT it sets (plugin D27b): AutoCAD solves the block's constraints again at a value set later only through that copy, and left an INSERT whose anonymous block held none, or one naming entities gone, as it was until RESETBLOCK.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfBlockConstraints.ReadGroup(GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfItem)
member.summary: Reads the nodes of a constraint group. A group of R2010 (AC1024) writes each node as its class (1), its group (330), its id (90), its flags (70) and the ids of the nodes it is tied to (a count, 90, and as many 90s), then the groups of its class, up to the next class; one of R2018 (AC1032), as AutoCAD 2021 saved its samples (plugin D27b), lists the classes and ids of its nodes first (a 1 and a 90 each) and writes each node as its id, the count and the ids it is tied to, its flags (70) and the same groups of its class, up to the next node's id so followed.

Reads the nodes of a group of R2018: the list of their classes and ids from the place given, then each node in the list's order, as says; false where they cannot be read so. The place of each node's groups of its class is kept counted in the group's record, from the offset given.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfBlockConstraints.OwningNetwork(GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfFile,GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfItem)
member.summary: The network that owns a network as an action of it (the 330 of its AcDbAssocAction); null where none does.

Writes a copy of the block's network into the anonymous block that stands for it, as AutoCAD 2021 copied it into the anonymous block of an INSERT it set (plugin D27b): under the entry ACAD_ASSOCNETWORK of a dictionary of the same name in the anonymous block's extension dictionary, each object of the network copied with a handle of its own, each handle naming the copy of what it named (an object of the network, or the copy of an entity of the block), the network listed by the network that owns the block's and given the next index of an action there, each dependency on a constraint parameter put last in the chain of the parameter's dependencies and among its reactors, and each copy of an entity given the reactors of its own. The copy holds the values set: each variable given its value at the values given (by name) and at the user parameters' given (by the handle of their variables), its expression the value's text where it was no expression of other variables and the value changed, whole or real as says, each dependency on a variable the value it read, each body of a dimension its value as the drawing writes lengths (LUPREC places, trailing zeros left out where DIMZIN says so) and each body of a parameter its name and that value, as AutoCAD wrote 612.3457 and Height=612.3457; and each geometry of the constraint groups the geometry of the copy of its entity, the actions having worked, as AutoCAD wrote the lines of its Window sample flipped. Nothing is written where the constraints hold a node the library does not read, the network is owned by no network, or a geometry's copy cannot be read.

member.name: T:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfConstraintExpression
member.summary: The expression of a variable of a block's constraints (AcDbCalc), as AutoCAD's Parameters Manager writes it: numbers, the names of other variables (letters of either case the same), + - * / % ^ and brackets, a sign before a term; so the samples' width-W3*2, Length-30 and HdCr/4; the constants pi and e, which AutoCAD 2021 read before a variable of the same name; and the functions AutoCAD's help lists but random, as AutoCAD 2021 worked them out (plugins D27b, D34): sin, cos, tan, asin, acos and atan, their angles in degrees as it read width*cos(60) as half the width; sinh, cosh, tanh, asinh, acosh, atanh, sqrt, exp, exp10, ln, log (of base 10), d2r and r2d; abs and sign; round, halves up as it gave round(-2.5) -2 and round(2.5) 3, trunc, floor and ceil; and min, max and pow of two values apart by a semicolon or a comma. Any other function, random, which AutoCAD draws anew each time, or anything else, is refused, and so is what AutoCAD 2021 would not work out: a root, a logarithm or an inverse of a value out of its range, a division or a remainder by nought, a remainder of a value not whole, and a round, trunc, floor or ceil past a whole number of 32 bits. A value is whole or real as AutoCAD 2021 kept it (plugins D27b, D34): a number written without a point or an exponent is whole, a sum, a difference or a product of whole values is whole, and a quotient, a power, pi and e are real, as it kept Length-30 whole and DIA/2 real; a remainder, round, trunc, floor, ceil and sign are whole, abs of the value's kind, min and max of the kind of the value they give, the first where the two are equal, and every other function real; and a whole value past 32 bits is real, as it kept 2147483647+1 as the real 2147483648.

member.summary: The text of a dimension's measurement, as AutoCAD writes it from the variables of its style: a length by DIMLFAC, DIMRND, DIMLUNIT, DIMDEC, DIMZIN, DIMDSEP, DIMFRAC and DIMPOST, its alternate units after it in brackets where DIMALT is on; an angle by DIMAUNIT, DIMADEC, DIMAZIN, DIMDSEP and DIMPOST.
member.remarks: A number is rounded as a .NET decimal of its 15 significant figures, half away from nought, so that 2.675 to two places is 2.68 and the text is the same under .NET Framework and .NET: the double nearest 2.675 lies just below it, and is read as the 2.675 its 15 figures give.

member.name: T:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDynamicBlockRepresentation
member.summary: Sets the value of a dynamic property of an INSERT as AutoCAD's DynamicBlockReferenceProperty.Value sets it, for a dynamic block of linear, XY, polar, point, rotation, flip, visibility and lookup parameters with the stretch, polar stretch, move, scale, rotate, flip, array and lookup actions the library writes, and the stretches and moves of a base grip, the moves carrying linear parameters and the attribute definitions in a stretch, a move, a scale and a rotate that AutoCAD's Block Editor writes: the value taken to its value set, the block worked out at the values of all its properties into an anonymous block of AutoCAD's (*U) the INSERT places, the INSERT's ATTRIBs changed as their ATTDEFs' places change, and the INSERT's representation data and cache (ACAD_ENHANCEDBLOCKDATA) written as AutoCAD 2021 wrote them when it set a value (plugins v17, v18), a history of grip edits the INSERT keeps given the value set after it and none made where it keeps none (plugin D26). A block properties table sets its row, its user parameters and the INSERT's attributes of its columns. A horizontal, a vertical or a radial constraint parameter AutoCAD's Block Editor wrote is set by solving the block's constraints () before the actions work, as AutoCAD 2021 solved its samples (plugin D27).

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDynamicBlockRepresentation.DragEnd(GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfBlockReference,GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDynamicBlockRepresentation.Param,System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary{System.String,System.Double[]},GeometryHelper.Geometry.GeoPoint3)

Drags a corner of an XY parameter other than its end corner to a point in the coordinates of the file: the corner of base x and end y ( 2) takes the distance along y from the base point, the corner of end x and base y (3) the one along x, each taken to its value set, and the base point moves along the other axis to the point, the end point staying, as the corner of AutoCAD 2021 did (plugins GhDb1 and GhDy2a).

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDynamicBlockRepresentation.CornerOf(GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDynamicBlockRepresentation.Param,System.Double[],System.Int32)
member.summary: The corner of an XY parameter at the values given: base x with end y ( 2), or end x with base y (3).

Works the grip edits of a polar parameter the INSERT's history keeps (ACAD_ENHANCEDBLOCKHISTORY) out one after the other, from the block's own base point and end point: the states the base point and the end point stood at, the block's own first and one after each record of the parameter's grips (GRIPLOC: the end point or the base point moved by the record's vector, in the block's coordinates) and of its distance and its angle (the distance or the angle set, the other and the base point kept, the Origin set: both points moved together), as AutoCAD 2021 did (plugin GhDb4a). Null where the edits (none where the INSERT keeps no history) end elsewhere than where the INSERT has the parameter now (): the library does not know how the INSERT came to stand there.

The values may stand after an edit () the INSERT does not keep yet, its state before it ; the same dictionary for the state the INSERT keeps.

member.summary: The ATTRIBs of a dynamic INSERT that follow their ATTDEF, with what each is given in the world to go from where the dynamic block's own values put it to where the INSERT's values put it, as works it out: an ATTRIB placed afresh from the dynamic block's definition, as ATTSYNC places one, is taken so where the actions take its definition (TAG locked at (95, 20) in a stretch of Width set from 100 to 150 by 50 along x). Empty where the INSERT places no dynamic block. Refused with where the block is one the library does not work out, or the INSERT keeps a base point a grip moved that refuses ().

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDynamicBlockRepresentation.UpdateAnonymous(GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfBlockTableRecord)
member.summary: Works out anew, as AutoCAD's UpdateAnonymousBlocks does once a dynamic block is defined anew, each anonymous block of it that an INSERT places: a new *U block made from the block as it is now, at the values of the first INSERT that places the old one, every INSERT of the old one turned to it with its representation data and cache written anew, and the old one left in the table placed by none. A panel whose INSERTs of Width 150 and 200 placed *U1 and *U2 has them placed by *U3 and *U4 once a circle is added to it, each holding the circle, as AutoCAD 2021 made them (plugin GhAn1); an anonymous block no INSERT places is passed over, as AutoCAD passed over *U1 and *U2 when it updated the panel again. One whose INSERT the library does not work out ( refuses it) is left as it was, and so are its INSERTs. The ATTRIBs of each INSERT that follow their ATTDEF (the ATTDEFs locked in the block and held by an action) are made anew from it as the new block holds it, their words kept: their place, height, rotation, colour and the rest are the definition's again, whatever the user gave them, and an ATTDEF added or erased makes or takes away none; the others are left as they were (plugin GhFm2f, a panel whose TAG ATTDEF was taller, turned and moved, and whose NOTE ATTDEF was moved and made oblique).
member.returns: The names of the anonymous blocks made, in the order of the table of those they take the place of.
member.exception: Thrown when the block is one the library does not work out.

member.summary: Makes anew from the definitions of the block the INSERT places now the ATTRIBs whose tag an ATTDEF of the dynamic block holds locked and an action works on, as does, their words kept.

Reads the values an INSERT has now, by the node of each parameter, into the values of its block's own: lengths and positions in the block's own units (the INSERT's divided by its scale), angles and flip states; the labels of its lookups and the values of its user parameters too.
member.returns: The name of the visibility state it shows; null where it names none.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDynamicBlockRepresentation.ReadShifts(GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfBlockReference,GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfBlockTableRecord,GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDynamicBlockRepresentation.Block,System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary{System.String,System.Double[]})
member.summary: Reads where the INSERT keeps the base point of each linear and XY parameter, against where the block has it (moved, as says, where a move carries the parameter), into the three values made after its distances: AutoCAD keeps a base point a grip moved where the INSERT saved it and works the actions from there, drawing the array of its XY sample's INSERT 2AE, whose base point a grip took from (0, 5) to (0, 104.30), at y 99.30 down to 19.30, and read Width 80 where a corner of a plate 100 by 50 was dragged by (20, 10) and kept its right edge at x 100 (plugin GhDy2a). A constraint parameter's base point is where the block's constraints put it, which a value set may move, and is not read. A stretch, a move or an array that follows the base point follows the base point where the INSERT keeps it, a value set after the move too: AutoCAD 2021 kept the left edge of a panel whose base point a grip took 10 along at x 10 when Width was set next, in memory and after the drawing was written to DXF or DWG and read back (plugin GhDb4a). Refused with where another kind of parameter keeps its base point away from the block's, a move carries the parameter that does, or a scale or a rotate follows it: the library works those out from the block's own base points. A linear parameter's base point may stand off its line, as AutoCAD 2021 left one whose Origin was set to a point beside it (plugin GhDb4a).

Moves the base point of a linear, an XY or a polar parameter by a vector in the coordinates of the file, as a grip of AutoCAD's does: the end point stays, so a distance of the parameter shrinks as the base point goes towards the end point (the vector worked into the block's coordinates, an XY parameter's along x and along y, a linear parameter's along its line alone, a polar parameter's anywhere). The distances the base point leaves are taken to the parameter's value set, and the base point stands where they put it, the end point staying: AutoCAD 2021 read Width 70 and the base point 30 of a panel of Width 50 to 300 by 10 whose base grip was dragged by 33, Width 50 and the base point 50 by 60, and of a polar parameter of Length 50 to 300 by 10 and angles every 15 degrees Length 80 and Angle 345 degrees by (20, 15) (plugin GhDy3a). An axis of an XY parameter the move leaves alone is not taken.

Takes the base point of a linear, an XY or a polar parameter to a point of the file's coordinates, the end point going with it, as AutoCAD 2021 set the Origin of each (plugin GhDb4a): the point worked into the block's coordinates, the base point's move from where the INSERT keeps it added to the move the INSERT keeps and to the one the actions that follow the base point follow, the distances kept, so that a stretch tied to the end point moves by the same: a panel 100 wide from (0, 100) whose Origin is set to (30, 120) runs from (30, 120) to (130, 120) and its edges, a stretch of the base point and a stretch of the end point, move by (30, 20). A linear parameter's moves off its line too.

member.summary: Adds a record to the history of grip edits the INSERT keeps (ACAD_ENHANCEDBLOCKHISTORY): the node's id (1071), a name (300, the property's, or GRIPLOC for a grip dragged) and the value, a real (40), a whole number (70), a text (1) or a point (11), as AutoCAD 2021 added Block Table1 2, Spaces 5 Spaces and Width 5400 to its Parking sample's (plugin D26). A record of the node and the name of the last one replaces it, as AutoCAD 2021 kept Width 120 alone of Width 140 and then 120, in one session or two, and one GRIPLOC of one grip dragged twice in a row, the two moves added. An INSERT of no history is given none, as AutoCAD gave none to the library's INSERTs it set, unless its block has a polar parameter or an array or a scale action: AutoCAD 2021 started the history (1070 3) at the first value set or grip dragged of a pointer, of a pointer with a linear parameter beside it, of a panel with an array and of a grid, and of a bar a scale action scales, and of no block of stretches, moves, rotates or flips alone (plugins GhDy3a and GhDb4a). A record of a grip dragged nowhere (a move of no more than 1E-12) is not kept, nor is one a grip's two drags bring back.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDynamicBlockRepresentation.Carried(GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDynamicBlockRepresentation.Block,System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary{System.String,System.Double[]})
member.summary: The move, in x and y, each parameter a move carries is given at the values given, by the parameter's id: the sum of the moves of the actions carrying it, each as gives it. A parameter carried keeps its distance, and its own actions do not follow its being carried (it does not chain them).

The ATTRIBs of the INSERT that follow their ATTDEF, told by its tag, as the actions take it from where the values before put it to where the values now put it, with what each is given in the world: the change of the ATTDEF's place in the block carried by the INSERT's placing. A move or a stretch moves it; a scale or a rotate scales or turns it about the parameter's base point, as AutoCAD 2021 scaled and turned the ATTRIBs of the library's (plugin D30, x2); a polar stretch turns it and moves it, or turns it only, as it does the ATTDEF (plugin D34, e5). An ATTRIB keeps a place the user gave it and changes by the change only. An ATTDEF not locked in the block takes no ATTRIB along, as AutoCAD 2021 left them (x1). Refused with where ATTDEFs of one tag the INSERT has an ATTRIB of change apart.
