member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDynamicBlockRepresentation.Transform(GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDynamicBlockRepresentation.Param,GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDynamicBlockRepresentation.BlockAction,System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary{System.String,System.Double[]})
member.summary: What an action of a kind does to its entities at the parameter's value: a move by the change of the point it follows, times its distance multiplier and turned by its angle offset; a scale about the base point by the distance over the block's own; a turn about the base point by the angle less the block's own; a mirror about the reflection line where flipped; null where it changes nothing.

Moves the points of the copies each stretch holds by its parameter's change: the end point now less the block's own, in x and y, times the stretch's distance multiplier and turned by its angle offset; a point held by several stretches moves by them all. A line moves its start or end, a polyline its vertex; an entity of one point moves whole; an arc held by both ends moves whole, by one end has that end moved, as says.

Works a polar stretch out on the copies at the values given, as AutoCAD 2021 worked out the library's (plugin D25): each point the stretch holds (a line's start or end, a polyline's vertex) turns about the parameter's base point by the angle less the block's own and then moves along the parameter's line by the distance less the block's own, as the end point does; the other points of the entities it holds turn alone, so a line from the base point to the end point keeps its start and follows with its end. An entity of one point held, or an arc held by both ends, and an entity of its selection holding no point (a grip of AutoCAD's own sample) are turned and moved whole; an entity it turns only (331) and does not select is turned whole: AutoCAD 2021 turned a tick it named so about the base point, and turned and moved it too when the selection named it besides. An attribute definition locked in the block is turned and moved, or turned only, so; one not locked stays where it is, as AutoCAD 2021 worked them out (plugin D34, e7 and e8).

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfDynamicBlockRepresentation.Bend(GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfArc,System.Double[],System.Double[])
member.summary: Moves the ends of an arc by the moves given, in x and y: both alike, the arc moves whole; else the arc is drawn anew through its ends moved, in its plane and its sense, keeping the height of its middle off its chord, as AutoCAD 2021 kept 2.929 for the arc of the radius 10 from (100, 25) to (90, 35) whose start went to (150, 25) and then to (200, 25), its radius becoming 159.37 and then 522.13 (plugin v20, 24d-k). An arc whose ends would meet within the point tolerance of moves whole by the move of its start.

Copies the entities of each array of the block, after the other actions and the visibility are worked out, into the anonymous block: along a linear parameter, a copy at each column spacing from the entity along the line from the base point to the end point, as many in all as the spacing goes whole into the distance, one at least; of an XY parameter, in rows and columns the way the end point lies, each count the distance along its axis over its spacing, rounded down, as AutoCAD's save of ACadSharp's XY sample shows (four columns of 25 in 100.59, five rows of 20 in 104.30), and none copied where a count is nought, as AutoCAD 2021 drew the one circle of that sample set to 80 by 5 (plugin v21, 24e-s2). The entity itself is the first copy; the others follow the block's entities cell by cell, row by row, each cell's in the order of the action's selection, and the arrays in the order of the graph, as AutoCAD 2021 drew them (C0 L0 C60 L60 ..., not C0 L0 C60 C120 ... L60, plugin D30), each tagged as AutoCAD tags a copy of its arrays (AcDbBlockArrayActionTag, 1070 1, after the entity's own tag), without which AutoCAD 2021 refused to set the INSERT again (eInvalidInput, plugin v21, 24e-c and 24e-d).

The INSERT's extension dictionary as AutoCAD writes it for an INSERT whose value it set: AcDbBlockRepresentation with the representation data (AcDbRepData) naming the dynamic block, and AppDataCache with a record for each parameter and action of the graph (ACAD_ENHANCEDBLOCKDATA, by the node's id, in the order of the ids as text), and for a flip parameter's grip as AutoCAD keeps one, and for each lookup parameter its label; none for an array or a lookup action, as AutoCAD's samples keep none; a record for each user parameter, its location and its value (1 a text, 40 a real), as AutoCAD 2021 kept Spaces of its Parking sample (plugin D26), and none for a block properties table, whose row is read from the values; the history of grip edits and its data kept as they are, as AutoCAD 2021 kept them (checks v22, D26). The record of a stretch or a move holds its angle offset (40), as AutoCAD 2021 kept 1.5707963267948966 for a move of a quarter turn, and moved along x, unturned, the circle of an INSERT whose record held nought (plugin v21, 24e-b).

Writes a polar stretch action driven by the end point of a polar parameter, as AutoCAD saved the polar stretch of ACadSharp's sample and of AutoCAD's own Annotation sample: the entities it stretches (330), its six connections (EndXDelta, EndYDelta, Base, End, UpdatedBase, UpdatedEnd), its frame of two corners (73, 1011), the entities it turns only (72, 331), each entity it stretches with the indices of its points inside the frame (74, 332, 75, 76), no codes (78), the distance multiplier 1 (141) and the angle offset nought (140), and 77 nought; one node, and the edge from the parameter (of six connections). An entity to turn only is not among the 330s: AutoCAD 2021 turned and moved a tick named there too, and turned it alone named among the 331s only (plugin D25).

member.summary: The name of the property a column of a block properties table sets, of its parameter's node and connection.

The value a column of a block properties table reads now, in the block's units, of the properties the parameter of its node gave: the distance of a linear, a polar or a constraint parameter (UpdatedDistance), the distance along x or along y of an XY parameter (UpdatedDistanceX, UpdatedDistanceY), the angle of a polar or a rotation parameter (UpdatedAngle), the x or the y of a point parameter (UpdatedX, UpdatedY), the text of a user parameter (UserVariable), the state of the visibility parameter (VisibilityState); null where the parameter gave none.

A user parameter, as a block properties table makes one, of text (170 of 5) or of a real (170 of 3): its name and its description, the first and the fourth text of the ACDBASSOCVARIABLE it names (330) after its count, and its value, the one the INSERT saved (1 or 40 of its data) else the variable's (the group after those four texts), a or a of no units, nothing allowed, as AutoCAD 2021 read Spaces of its Parking sample and Size of its Concrete Pipe (plugin D26). A user parameter of another kind gives no property; false then.

A constraint parameter a block properties table reads: its distance (305 its label, 306 its description), the length between its two points along x of a horizontal one, along y of a vertical one, and straight of an aligned or a radial one, as AutoCAD 2021 read Width and Height of its Fluorescent sample (plugin D26); of no allowed value, as AutoCAD read them. A horizontal, a vertical or a radial one is set by solving the block's constraints (, plugin D27); an aligned one is not set, as no sample showed its working.

The property Origin of a parameter that has a base point, after the properties the parameter gave: the base point the INSERT saved of it, else the block's own, in the block's coordinates (a , not scaled), of the kind 12, no units, not shown and visible where the parameter is, as AutoCAD 2021 read it of a linear, an XY, a polar, a rotation and a constraint parameter, and of no other (plugin GhDy3a). Read only for a rotation and a constraint parameter, as AutoCAD read it; bound to the INSERT where it is set, and not otherwise.

member.name: T:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfFile
member.summary: A DXF file opened to be saved again, with nothing of it lost: every byte of it is kept, and what it holds is read from them when asked for, its entities with the library's shapes for them.

remarks.para: Opened and saved with nothing changed, a file is written back byte for byte as it was read: its version, its line ends, its group codes padded or not, its mark of UTF-8 or none, its code page, its comments, and every section, table, entity and object of it, those the library does not read (HATCH, DIMENSION, LAYOUT, DICTIONARY, extended data and the rest) as well as those it does. A file that refuses is refused the same way, a binary DXF and one with no EOF among them.

The entities of the drawing are in and , those of the blocks in , each a whose are what reads of it with its default options: in the coordinates of the file, as it prints them, shapes of space, no INSERT placed and no unit scaled. is the faster way to read a drawing into shapes alone; this class is the way to save it again.

The entities of the drawing can be changed, added and removed: an entity given a new or a new look has its record written anew, every group the change is not about kept as it was, and every other record of the file is saved with its own bytes. Editing is for one thread at a time.

member.summary: Opens a DXF file from its text.
member.param: The text of the file, as or gives it.
member.returns: The file, its text kept as the bytes AutoCAD would have saved it in.
member.exception: Thrown when the text is null.
Thrown when the text is not a DXF, is binary, or is cut short; the message names the line.
member.remarks: A text all ASCII, as writes one, or one of R2007 or later, or one that begins with a byte order mark, is kept as UTF-8, the mark as the mark of UTF-8, so gives it back, the mark left out as it leaves out that of a file, and writes it so. One of an earlier version with letters beyond ASCII is kept in the code page its header names ($DWGCODEPAGE, ANSI_1252 where it names none), as AutoCAD reads it, each letter the page lacks as its escape, and every letter beyond ASCII as its escape where the runtime has not the page: the text of R2004 of an MTEXT café Đ, its page ANSI_1252, is kept as caf, the byte E9 and \U+0110, which every reader reads as café Đ, and gives it with the escape.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfFile.Pointed(GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfFile.Rec,GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfFile,GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfFile,System.Boolean@,System.String)
member.summary: A record of a copy with its pointers into the drawing it was copied from taken to this one (): each soft or hard pointer (320 to 369, 390 to 399, 480 and 481) to the object of the same name there, a table's record by its name, an object of the named object dictionary (a material, a plot style, a visual style) by the names of its dictionary and of its entry; left out where the target has none of that name, so that the target's default holds. A handle of extended data (1005) is kept in its place as null (0), as AutoCAD's mapping of objects between drawings leaves it, or held back for the copy of an entity copied with it while blocks are being copied; but one of the overrides of a dimension style (ACAD DSTYLE, a 1070 of the variable then a 1005 of its record: DIMBLK, DIMLTYPE, DIMTXSTY and the others) names the record of the same name in the target, the two left out where it has none, said in the log; in a target of R12 an arrow block's (DIMBLK, DIMBLK1, DIMBLK2) names the block by its name, a 1070 of 5, 6 or 7 then a 1000, as R12 writes it, where the target has a block of that name. A pointer to an entity copied with the one being added, as a table cell's to an attribute definition (331) of the block copied with the table, names its copy; such a pointer left out takes its value (300) with it, the cell's count (179) made to agree. A LEADER whose annotation (340) is left out points to none (73 of 3). While blocks are being copied with an entity, a pointer to an entity of the drawing copied from, and a HATCH's handle of a boundary object (330), is held back, marked, to be taken to its copy once every entity is written (), and says so. A MULTILEADER's attribute definition (its 330 after its own marker) names the copy of the definition, or the definition of the same tag in the block here of the name of its block, as the block it places is the one of that name here; where there is none, the value given for it (its 177, 44 and 302) goes with it. A pointer to a block being copied with it whose record is not written yet is held back so too, to name the copy (): a MULTILEADER's content block (341 of the context, 344) and arrow blocks (342, 345), an ACAD_TABLE's picture (343) and the block of a cell (340), and the arrow block an override of a dimension style names (DIMBLK, DIMBLK1, DIMBLK2, DIMLDRBLK), whose 1070 waits with it. The record itself where nothing changes.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfFile.CopyDynamicBlocks(GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfFile,GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfFile.InsertCopies)
member.summary: Copies what makes the dynamic blocks of another drawing dynamic into this one, after DxfDatabase.Insert or WblockCloneObjects copied its entities and blocks (), as AutoCAD's insert keeps it: the extended data of each dynamic block copied (its true name, GUID and tags) and the entries ACAD_ENHANCEDBLOCK (the evaluation graph with its nodes) and AcDbDynamicBlockRoundTripPurgePreventer of its extension dictionary; the extended data AcDbBlockRepBTag and the entry AcDbBlockRepresentation of each copy of an anonymous block that stands for one; and the entry AcDbBlockRepresentation (the representation data and the cache of the values) of each INSERT copied that stands for one. Each object comes with every object it owns, given a handle of its own here, in the order the other drawing owns them, once for each owner here; every handle among them names the copy of what it named: an object copied with it, an entity copied, the block copied or this drawing's own of the name, a record of a table of the same name, else null (0). A dynamic block of a name this drawing has is this drawing's own: what stands for it stands for this drawing's where that is dynamic, else comes static. The classes of the objects are listed and the applications of their extended data registered. Nothing in a drawing older than R2010, in which the library writes no dynamic block, nor where the other drawing has none.

member.name: T:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfInsert
member.summary: An INSERT of a DXF file as holds it in : the block it places, where, turned and scaled how, and the array of a MINSERT, as the file gives them, nothing placed.

remarks.para: The INSERT of the block BOLT at (100, 50) on the floor, turned 90 degrees and scaled by 2 along x, is BOLT, (100, 50, 0), (0, 0, 1), pi / 2, 2 and the other scales 1, one column and one row. gives the entities of the block placed where it puts them, as reads them in .
It cannot be changed once made, and two INSERTs are the same only where they are one object: it does not compare its numbers.

member.summary: Gets how far the block is turned about , in radians counter-clockwise from the x axis of the normal's own system: group 50 in degrees made radians, from nought up to but not including 2 pi, so -90 degrees is 3 pi / 2.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfInsert.GetPlacedEntities
member.summary: Gets the entities of the block placed where the INSERT puts them, each cell of a MINSERT's array in turn, as reads them with its default options: each shape placed, layer 0 and BYBLOCK taking the INSERT's look, an INSERT inside the block placed within it, and each with the names of its blocks in .
member.returns: The entities placed, a new list on each call, in world coordinates for an INSERT of the drawing and in the block's own for one inside a block, which is placed within that block as places it. Empty where the reader places nothing: the block is not defined, is an external reference or a layout, or would take the entities placed past by its default, which each call counts afresh.

remarks.para: Each call is a placing of its own, and gives the same whatever was placed before it. The names of the layers are spelled as the layer table spells them, then as the entities of the drawing first spell them, then as the placed entities first spell them, two names differing only in case being one layer. Where a layer the table does not list is spelled in more than one case in the file, a placed entity may carry another of those spellings than the reader gives it, which takes the first it has met in its own order of reading.

The blocks worked out for the sizes of INSERTs, at most 1 000 000, are for all the calls on one file together, as they are for one reading; once they are spent, an INSERT whose size would need one more is not placed.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfInsert.GetPlacedEntities(System.Collections.Generic.IReadOnlyList{System.String}@)
member.summary: Gets the entities of the block placed where the INSERT puts them, as does, and what the reader has to say of what it did not place.
member.param: What the reader says of the placing, each a sentence: an INSERT of a block the file does not define, of a block inside itself, past the bound, and each type of entity of the block it did not place with the reasons, such as 1 HATCH not placed: 1 of a type that is not read. Empty where everything was placed.
member.returns: The entities placed, a new list on each call.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfInsert.ToString
member.summary: Gives the INSERT as a line for debugging: its block, where it stands and its turn.
member.returns: The INSERT as a line, such as INSERT BOLT at (100, 50, 0), turned 1.571.

member.name: T:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfItem
member.summary: An entity of a : its type, its look as its record writes it, every group of it as the file has it, and the library's shapes for it, read from the file the first time they are asked for.

remarks.para: is what reads of the entity, with its options left at their defaults and the INSERT placing nothing: a for a LINE, a for a closed LWPOLYLINE with bulges, a for a TEXT, a for an INSERT, and none for a HATCH, a DIMENSION and the other types the reader does not read, which the file keeps as they are. is the one shape of an entity read as one, which is nearly every entity read.

The look is the groups of the record as written, so that what is read can be written back as it was: a colour BYBLOCK is the colour 0 and BYLAYER 256, where reads both as none; a lineweight by layer is -1; a layer is spelled with any space around it and any escape in it. Nothing is taken from a block: a LINE of a block on layer 0 is on layer 0.

An entity of model space or paper space can be changed: its , its layer, colour, true colour, linetype, lineweight and thickness are set, and its record is written anew, every group the change is not about kept as the file had it. A setter given the value its getter gives changes nothing. An entity of a block cannot be changed yet, nor one removed from its space.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfItem.#ctor(GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfFile,GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfFile.Piece,System.String)
member.summary: An entity added to the file, its records its own.

member.summary: A record that follows an entity, an ATTRIB of an INSERT, seen as an entity of its own: its one record is that record of the entity's, read and written through the entity, and it is erased with it.

member.name: P:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfItem._file
member.summary: The file the item's records are in: a record that follows an entity is in the entity's, and goes with it when an entity made in code is added to a file.

member.name: P:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfItem.Parent
member.summary: The entity whose record this is, for a record that follows one; null otherwise. The entity's item once it is added to a file, as the followers of an entity made in code go with it.

member.name: P:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfItem.Index
member.summary: Which record of this is: 1 for the first that follows it; kept as followers are put in or taken out before it.

member.name: P:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfItem.Followers
member.summary: The items of the records that follow the entity, by the index of the record (none at 0), each made the first time it is asked for by ; null until one is.

member.name: P:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfItem.Type
member.summary: Gets the type of the entity as the file names it, such as LINE, LWPOLYLINE, HATCH or INSERT; the type of its new shape once is set to one written as another, as a LINE given a circle is a CIRCLE.

member.name: P:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfItem.Handle
member.summary: Gets the handle of the entity (group 5), as the file writes it in hexadecimal, the spaces around it taken off; null where it has none, as in a file of R12. A new shape keeps it.

member.name: P:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfItem.Layer
member.summary: Gets or sets the layer of the entity (group 8) as its record writes it, any space around the name and any escape in it (\U+00E9) kept; null where the record gives none, which the reader takes as layer 0.
member.value: Set, the name as it is to be written, letters beyond ASCII in the file's code page, or as their escapes where the page has them not; null takes the group out. A layer the layer table does not list, letters of either case the same, is added to it, in the colour 7 with the linetype CONTINUOUS, and the log says so. The vertices and the end of a POLYLINE, and the end of an INSERT's attributes, are put on it too, as AutoCAD keeps them.
member.exception: Thrown when the name set is empty, has a space at either end, or has a control character or one of < > / " : ; ? * | = ` in it, which AutoCAD does not take in a name.
Thrown when the entity is of a block or removed.

member.name: P:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfItem.Colour
member.summary: Gets or sets the colour of the entity (group 62) as its record writes it: an AutoCAD colour index from 1 to 255, 0 for BYBLOCK and 256 for BYLAYER, below nought for a colour turned off; null where the record gives none, or one that is not a whole number.
member.value: Set, from 0 to 256; null takes the group out, which leaves the colour to the layer.
member.exception: Thrown when the colour set is below 0 or above 256.
Thrown when the entity is of a block or removed.

member.name: P:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfItem.TrueColour
member.summary: Gets or sets the colour of the entity as red, green and blue (group 420) as its record writes it, 0xRRGGBB, with whatever the file puts above those 24 bits; null where the record gives none, or one that is not a whole number.
member.value: Set, from 0 to 0xFFFFFF; null takes the group out.
member.exception: Thrown when the colour set is below 0 or above 0xFFFFFF.
Thrown when the entity is of a block or removed, or a colour is set in a file older than R2004 (AC1018), which has no true colours.

member.name: P:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfItem.Linetype
member.summary: Gets or sets the name of the linetype of the entity (group 6) as its record writes it, such as DASHED, BYLAYER or ByBlock; null where the record gives none, which takes the linetype of the layer.
member.value: Set, a linetype of the file's linetype table, letters of either case the same, or BYLAYER or BYBLOCK; null takes the group out.
member.exception: Thrown when the linetype set is not in the file's linetype table.
Thrown when the entity is of a block or removed.

member.name: P:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfItem.Lineweight
member.summary: Gets or sets the lineweight of the entity (group 370) as its record writes it, in hundredths of a millimetre: 25 for a line 0.25 wide, -1 by layer, -2 by block and -3 the default; null where the record gives none, or one that is not a whole number.
member.exception: Thrown when the lineweight set is not one of AutoCAD's.
Thrown when the entity is of a block or removed, or a lineweight is set in a file older than R2000 (AC1015), which has no lineweights.

member.name: P:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfItem.Thickness
member.summary: Gets or sets the thickness of the entity (group 39), how far it stands up along its extrusion; nought where the record gives none, or one that is not a finite number.
member.value: Set, a finite number; nought takes the group out.
member.exception: Thrown when the thickness set is not a finite number.

Thrown when the entity is of a block or removed, or a thickness other than nought is set on a type that has none: those that have one are the LINE, POINT, CIRCLE, ARC, LWPOLYLINE, POLYLINE, TEXT, SOLID and TRACE.

member.name: P:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfItem.Groups
member.summary: Gets every group of the entity's record, in the order of the file, after the group 0 that names its type, each value the text the file prints; read from the file on each call, a new list each time.
member.remarks: Of a POLYLINE they run on through its VERTEX records and its SEQEND, and of an INSERT with attributes through its ATTRIB records and its SEQEND, each opened by its own group 0, as has them. A comment (group 999) is not among them, though the file keeps it.

member.name: P:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfItem.Shapes
member.summary: Gets the library's shapes for the entity, read from the file the first time they are asked for and kept: what reads of it with its default options, in the coordinates of the file, the entity's own where it is in a block; for an INSERT, its .
member.remarks: Nearly every entity read is one shape. The reader reads two of a 3DFACE whose four corners are not in one plane, the triangles it is cut into, and of a polyface mesh of fewer than the four faces a body needs, each face; none of a type it does not read, such as HATCH, DIMENSION or ATTRIB, nor of an entity with no shape to it, such as a LINE of no length. An entity of paper space is read as one of model space is. Asked for from several threads at once, the shapes are read once all the same, or read twice and one reading kept: every thread gets the same list. Once the entity is changed, they are read again from its new record.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfItem.ShapesKept
member.summary: The shapes as the item keeps them: the one shape itself where there is one and the list of has not been asked for, else the list; read from the file the first time, and read again when it is not kept (a record that follows an entity).

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfItem.IsList(System.Object)
member.summary: Whether what the item keeps of its shapes is a list: the two kinds it makes, and not a shape, which is no read-only collection of its own.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfItem.ShapesOrOne(System.Object@)
member.summary: The shapes of the entity for a drawing to walk without making a list of them: the list where it keeps one, else null and its one shape, which a build of a million entities asked for each, making 24 bytes of list and 48 of enumerator for it.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfItem.ReadShapes
member.summary: The shapes read from the record now: a LINE, ARC, CIRCLE or LWPOLYLINE read from its bytes, the shape itself as the item keeps it; any other the reader's, as keeps them.

member.name: P:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfItem.Shape
member.summary: Gets or sets the one shape of the entity: the shape of where it has one, the same object each time; null where it has none or more than one.

value.para: Set, the shape the entity is written from anew, by the overload of 's Add for it: a LINE given a from (0, 0, 0) to (100, 0, 0) is that segment, its handle, owner, layer, look, reactors, extension dictionary and extended data kept as they were and in their order, and every group the reader does not take for its geometry kept with them. A shape written as another type changes the type, the handle staying: a LINE given a is a CIRCLE, and what the old type alone has, such as the style of a TEXT, is left out. A TEXT or an MTEXT takes a . The thickness is kept where the new type has one; the widths of a polyline are not kept. The shape is written as the file's version holds it: in a file of R12, a chain or loop of the plane as a POLYLINE with its VERTEX records, read back exactly as the lightweight polyline is, and no subclass markers. The extents of the header grow to hold it.
The shape is read back from the new record the next time it is asked for: the segment of the LINE to the bit, the shapes of the plane as the shapes of space the reader gives.

member.exception: Thrown when the shape set is null.

Thrown when the shape set is not one writes without a tolerance, is written as more than one entity (a face with holes, a body, a box), or as a type the file's version cannot hold and has no exact form of its own for: a SPLINE, ELLIPSE, MTEXT, RAY or XLINE in a file of R12.

Thrown when the entity is of a type that has no shape of the library's to set (HATCH, DIMENSION, INSERT and the other types the reader does not read, and a LEADER or a MULTILEADER, which it reads as its lines), of a block, or removed. A LEADER or a MULTILEADER given null changes nothing, as before the reader read them.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfItem.Listed(System.Collections.Generic.List{System.Object})
member.summary: The shapes read as the item keeps them: the shared empty list for none, the shape itself for one, which most entities have, a read-only list for more.

member.name: T:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfJoin
member.summary: Curves joined into a source curve, as AutoCAD's JoinEntity and JoinEntities join them by the rules of its JOIN: lines along the line of a LINE and arcs of the circle of an ARC, or of the ellipse of an ELLIPSE, gaps and all; lines, arcs and polylines of its plane end to end into a polyline of the plane; lines and straight polylines into a 3D polyline; and lines, arcs, elliptical arcs, polylines and splines into a SPLINE. The source is written anew; the others are left as they are.
member.remarks: Ends meet where they are within the point tolerance. Pieces joined end to end are chained on from the source's end, then back from its start, each time the one of lowest index of those with an end at the end reached, found through an index of their ends in cells as wide as the tolerance, so that 10 000 pieces in any order are chained in time along their count.

member.summary: Joins entities into a source, as says: the indices of those joined, in increasing order. Where , the one entity given is joined or refused with why.
member.exception: Thrown for an entity that is null, erased or the source itself; where single, for one that is not joined.
Thrown when the source is erased, or has no ends to join at.
Thrown for a source of a class AutoCAD's JOIN takes no others into.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfMTextLayout.Of(GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfFont,GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfFonts.Big,System.String,System.Double,System.Double,System.Double,System.Boolean,System.Boolean,System.Boolean)
member.summary:
The words of an MTEXT, its codes as reads them, laid out in a font at a height, wrapped at a width (none at nought), the lines spaced by a factor of single spacing at least or exactly; null where a letter is not measured. AutoCAD 2021 lays them out so (check F4):
A line may break after the spaces between words, which are left at the end of the line it breaks, and before and after each Chinese, Japanese or Korean letter, as says; a word moves down where the line, as wide as measures it, would reach the width, a word longer than the width left whole on a line of its own. Spaces before the first word are a word of their own: " ABC DEF GHI" of txt.shx 4 high, 15 wide, begins with a line of its two spaces.
At least: the first baseline stands the first line's below the top, and the top of each line the factor times the top of the line before, a third of that line's height and a third of the MTEXT's height below the top of the line before it, so that a line of taller letters is the more below the line before it; the MTEXT as high as from the top to the foot of the last line, its ink below its baseline counted. gdt.shx "x\Py" 4 high has its second baseline 8.667 below its first, its y 2 higher than the height, and txt.shx "ABC\P{\H3x;g}\PDEF" its baselines 14.667 and 9.333 apart.
Exactly: the baselines the MTEXT's height below the top and the factor times five thirds of it apart, the MTEXT as high as its height, the spacing of each line after the first and a third of its height, whatever the letters.
An empty paragraph at the end is no line, but one more is; one before it is a line as high as the letters where it is.
A stack (\S1/2;), where asks for it, is laid out by : the line holding it is as high as the stack, 0.42 for letters 0.18 high, with its baseline that of the stack's denominator, and the line after it stands as far below it as the stack is high, not as the height of the letters and a third of it. txt.shx "A\S1/2;B" 0.18 high held at the top left has its A and its denominator 0.42 below the top and its numerator 0.24 above them.
Where asks for it, letters struck through (\K) are no look of their own (they are one TEXT with the letters about them), and each line has the AutoCAD 2021 draws through them when it saves R12.
Lays out the letters of a paragraph, from one place up to another, in lines wrapped at a width, adding each line's span and its letters measured; false where a letter is not measured.

A stack in a stretch is not lined through whole: where the stretch begins at it the numerator's words are, and the denominator has a line of no length, and where struck letters come before it the numerator has one of no length too (at the bar, as high as the numerator's baseline, or half the height above it for a stack with no denominator); the letters of the stretch after it have a line of no length at the denominator.

member.summary: The changes a makes to its NURBS data, worked on the control points in homogeneous form (x w, y w, z w, w): knots put in by Boehm's rule, the degree raised, the spline cut and run on past its ends, fitted by least squares, and made to pass a point in a direction; after Piegl and Tiller, The NURBS Book (A2.1, A2.3, A5.1, A5.9, A9.7).
member.remarks: The knots are those of a clamped spline, the first and last degree and one times each, as AutoCAD writes a spline that is not periodic. Every change but the degree raised and the cut keeps the curve where it was; those two keep it exactly.

member.summary: The basis functions of a span and their first derivatives at a parameter (A2.3, to the first order), as two rows of degree and one numbers each.

The clamped spline of a degree and a count of control points that fits points given at parameters best by least squares (A9.7), passing through the first and the last: its knots spread over the parameters as The NURBS Book's (9.69) spreads them, so that every span holds some of the points.
member.exception: Thrown when the system has no solution, as for points that leave a span empty.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfNurbsEdit.IsPeriodicForm(System.Int32,System.Collections.Generic.List{System.Double},System.Collections.Generic.List{System.Double[]})
member.summary: Whether a spline clamped at both ends has a periodic form, as AutoCAD 2021 gives one to a spline of the flag 2048: unclamped at its start and at its end (A12.1), the first degree of its control points the same as the degree a period on, within and of its size (one and the largest of its coordinates), and of the same weights within of the largest. AutoCAD's periodic splines it saved are so to 1.3E-15 of their size, its cubic of 7 control points and the knots 0, 0, 0, 0, 30, 45, 55, 80, 80, 80, 80 to 1E-13; its 2059 of a point beside its seam moved by 1E-11, off by 4.1E-11, it read as periodic, and moved by 1E-10, off by 4.1E-10, as not (its 17-w). Its periodic cubic through three points, of 6 control points clamped, it read as periodic too (D32 ring3-periodic). False where the spline has fewer points than the degree and three (3 for a degree of 1), or knots the unclamping cannot divide by.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfNurbsEdit.PeriodicPolygon(System.Int32,System.Collections.Generic.List{System.Double},System.Collections.Generic.List{System.Double[]})
member.summary: The control points of one period of the periodic spline that a spline clamped at both ends is, in AutoCAD's periodic form (the form makes, and SPLINEDIT's Close of control points): the curve unclamped at its start (A12.1), the point of the period AutoCAD calls the first at index degree of the unclamped points. A cubic of 10 control points and the knots 0, 0, 0, 0, 1 to 6, 7, 7, 7, 7 gives the 7 points the closing was made of. Null where the spline has fewer points than the degree and two (3 for a degree of 1), or knots the unclamping cannot divide by.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfNurbsEdit.Unmix(System.Double[],System.Double[],System.Double,System.Double)
member.summary: The point that, mixed as a of it and b of another, gives a third: (q - b other) / a, coordinate by coordinate.

The cubic through fit points as AutoCAD 2021 fits a spline that is not periodic, whatever degree it is asked: the points one after another within its point tolerance taken as one ( and of their size), each on the curve at its knot, the knots the lengths of the chords from the first point and the ends four times each, so that n points give n and 2 control points; at an end given a tangent the derivative there that tangent as it is, by the length along the chords, and at an end given none (or one of no length) the curve bent no more, its second derivative nought (The NURBS Book, 9.2.2 and (3.9), as ezdxf's fit_points_to_cad_cv has it). Through (0, 0), (30, 40) and (60, 0) it is (0, 0), (10, 20), (30, 60), (50, 20) and (60, 0) over the knots 0, 0, 0, 0, 50, 100, 100, 100, 100, as AutoCAD fitted it; through five points, alone or given tangents of length 1 or 5, the library's control points are AutoCAD's to 1E-13 (its D32 run). The knots go up by the square root of each chord, or by 1 from point to point, where the parameters asked are those (AutoCAD's SqrtChord and Uniform, the same cubic else: through five points 0, 1, 2, 3 and 4, its control points AutoCAD's to 3E-14, its D32b run). False where the points are all one, or the system has no solution.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfNurbsEdit.Step(System.Double,GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfKnotParameterizationEnum)
member.summary: The step of the parameter from a point to the next a chord apart: the chord, its square root, or 1.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfNurbsEdit.Parameters(System.Int32)
member.summary: The parameters a SPLINE's group 70 says its fit points are given, as AutoCAD 2021 writes them: by the square root of the chord where the flag 64 is set (its 1096), one step each where 128 is (1160), else by the chord (1064, 32).

Whether AutoCAD 2021 reads a SPLINE of fit points as another curve than its control points give, and that curve: it fits every SPLINE of two fit points or more anew through them when it reads it, as does, whatever its flags, degree and control points (its D32 run: a control point moved by 1, the knots doubled, the degree 2 or 5, the flags 8 or 40 in place of 1064, all read as the fit), save one of the flag 2048 of a periodic spline, which AutoCAD writes with no fit points, and one of a fit tolerance above 1E-10, which it fits otherwise. True where that fit is not the record's own (: another degree or count, weights, knots not the chords, or a condition of the fit not met within its point tolerance). AutoCAD's own splines of fit points are their fit to 3E-13, so that they are read as their records hold them, to the bit; the library's 17-g of v9, closed cubics of 70 11 through 5 and 6 fit points, are not, and AutoCAD read them as their fits.

Whether a record's control points and knots are the cubic fits through fit points, told without fitting: a cubic of no weights other than 1, of as many points and knots, its knots the chords' lengths, and every condition the fit is solved for met within and of the points' size: its ends the first and last fit points, its point at each inner knot the fit point there, and at each end the derivative the tangent gives, or no second derivative where none is given. The system having one solution, a curve that meets them is the fit's.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfNurbsEdit.EndHolds(GeometryHelper.Geometry.GeoPoint3,GeometryHelper.Geometry.GeoPoint3,GeometryHelper.Geometry.GeoPoint3,System.Double,System.Double,GeometryHelper.Geometry.GeoVector3,GeometryHelper.Tolerance)
member.summary: Whether an end of a cubic meets the condition of there: the derivative from its end point towards the next the tangent, by the first span over 3, or of no tangent, no second derivative.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfNurbsEdit.OneEach(System.Collections.Generic.IReadOnlyList{GeometryHelper.Geometry.GeoPoint3},GeometryHelper.Tolerance@)
member.summary: The fit points, one after another within AutoCAD's point tolerance of their size taken as one, and that tolerance.

The periodic spline of a degree through points taken round, the last back to the first, as AutoCAD 2021 fits a periodic spline: each point on the curve at its knot, the knots the lengths of the chords from the first point, the m points' system solved for the m control points of a period, then clamped at the first knot and again a period on, as AutoCAD writes it, m and the degree control points and the end knots the degree and one times each. Its cubic through (0, 0), (40, 1), (50, 30) and (10, 25) is that of its 17-l to 1E-14: the knots 0, 40.01, 70.69, 111.00 and 137.93, the control points (0, 0), (4.78, -9.71), (44.07, -9.27), (60.39, 41.46), (8.49, 34.10), (-3.22, 6.53) and (0, 0). Three points give the cubic of three control points to a period, as AutoCAD fitted one through (0, 0), (30, 0) and (20, 15) (its D32 ring3-periodic, to 1E-13); the knots go up by the square root of each chord or by 1 where those parameters are asked. False where there are fewer points than 3 and fewer than the degree and one, a chord is of no length, or the system has no solution, as for any spline of an even degree through an even count of points, whose system is singular.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfNurbsEdit.SolveSparse(System.Collections.Generic.List{System.Int32}[],System.Collections.Generic.List{System.Double}[],System.Double[][])
member.summary: Solves a square system of few entries to a row, each row its columns rising and their entries, for three right sides: Gaussian elimination with the largest entry of each column as pivot, the first row of two as large, the rows kept as their entries alone, so that a ring of 5 000 points costs 5 000 short rows and not a square of 25 million; null where the system has no solution.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfNurbsEdit.Subtract(System.Collections.Generic.List{System.Int32}[],System.Collections.Generic.List{System.Double}[],System.Int32,System.Int32,System.Double)
member.summary: Takes a factor of the pivot's row from a row whose first entry it clears, the entries left in their columns' order, none of nought kept.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfNurbsEdit.SolveBand(System.Double[0:,0:],System.Double[0:,0:])
member.summary: Solves a symmetric system that is nought beyond a band of its diagonal, given as the band's upper half (row i, column d the entry at i, i + d), for three right sides: the band factored as U^T U by Cholesky, then the two triangles solved.
member.exception: Thrown when the system is not positive definite, as for points that leave a span empty.

member.summary: The transformation seen from the system of an extrusion, carried into the system of the image of that extrusion, as AutoCAD 2021's TransformBy takes the normal of a circle, an arc, a polyline, a SOLID or a text: the old normal moved by the transformation. Where the transformation does not reflect, that is the extrusion the axes make, so the same as ; a mirror turns the cross product of the images of the axes the other way round, and the extrusion kept here is the image: a circle mirrored across a vertical plane keeps its normal (0, 0, 1) and one mirrored across its own plane has (0, 0, -1), its centre in the world where it was.

member.summary: The hatch pattern files of a drawing, found in the folders of its in their order and read once each, by the full path of the file; and the patterns in them as AutoCAD 2021 reads them (check P4c): ANSI31 of acadiso.pat, 45, 0,0, 0,3.175, one line at 45 degrees through the origin whose next copy lies 3.175 across it.
member.remarks: A pattern is looked for in acadiso.pat for a drawing of millimetres and acad.pat for one of inches, and in a file named after it (GRID.pat for GRID): a pattern of the drawing's own file first and the other after, a custom one the other way round, as AutoCAD 2021 looks for them; each file in the first folder that has it, and the first pattern of the name in it. A pattern AutoCAD would refuse is refused: a line of fewer than five numbers or more than six dashes, a number it cannot read, or a pattern of no line. A pattern in neither file is said once at Debug; one refused, or a file that cannot be read, once at Warn. Nothing throws.

member.name: T:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfPolylineFit
member.summary: The fitting AutoCAD does to a POLYLINE: the points of a uniform B-spline on a frame of vertices, for a polyline fitted with a spline (SPLINETYPE, SPLINESEGS) or a mesh smoothed into a surface (SURFTYPE, SURFU, SURFV); and the pairs of arcs of a polyline fitted with a curve.

remarks.para: The B-spline is AutoCAD's as its PEDIT describes it: on the frame as control points, of the degree the type says (2 for quadratic, 3 for cubic, one less than the points where there are fewer), clamped to the first and last points of an open frame and running round a closed one; its knots one step apart. A polyline is given SPLINESEGS segments for each span between two knots; a mesh SURFU by SURFV spans, from end to end of an open direction, one point more than the spans there, and round a closed one.

A curve fit puts a pair of arcs on each segment, meeting at a vertex the fitting adds, with the tangent at each vertex the one given (flag 2 and group 50) or Akima's blend of the segments either side, the ends of an open polyline taking the circle through the first or last three, as AutoCAD 2021's PEDIT Fit does to 1E-11 (probed on 60 polylines). A segment whose tangents are within a millionth of a radian of its line stays straight, with no vertex added.

A segment of no length splits the frame into runs fitted each on its own; a run of two vertices is its chord, and one of a single vertex has no tangent (nought).

member.summary: The pair of arcs AutoCAD 2021 puts on a segment from one point to another, leaving the first along one tangent and reaching the second along another: where the arcs meet, and the bulge of each. False, and no arcs, where either tangent is within a millionth of a radian of the chord's line, or is nought: the segment stays straight, as AutoCAD keeps it.

member.name: T:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfR12Explosion
member.summary: Breaks what R12 cannot hold into what it can, in a drawing of a later version, before it is written as R12, as AutoCAD 2021 does when it saves one as R12: an LWPOLYLINE is a POLYLINE, an ellipse or a spline the 3D POLYLINE of 128 segments, a ray or an infinite line a LINE to the extents of the drawing (of no length at its base point in a block), an MTEXT, a pattern HATCH, a LEADER, a MULTILEADER, an MLINE, a MESH and a table the lines, texts and polylines they break into, a 3DSOLID, a REGION, a BODY and a surface the lines, circles, arcs, points and 3D polylines of the edges of their faces; a space or a block gets an INSERT of a block of those pieces where the entity stood, but for the curves that are one polyline or line, which keep their place and handle. A dynamic block is given the anonymous name AutoCAD writes for it. What breaks into nothing is left out.
member.remarks: The pieces are made in a block of the drawing of their own (GHR12_ and the handle), so that the text of the drawing has them as records, which places where the entity stood.

member.name: T:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfRecovery
member.summary: The tolerant reading of a damaged DXF, as reads one: the bytes taken as pairs of lines however they are broken, the sections, blocks and polylines closed, the numbers, handles and owners set right, and the file written again where anything was, so that reads it as it reads a sound one. A sound file is given back as its own bytes. The ideas are ezdxf's recover module (MIT): pairs read on past a line that is not a group code, records outside every section gathered, and a number read from what it begins with; the code is the library's own.

member.name: T:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfShxFont
member.summary: A compiled SHX font of letters, of AutoCAD's forms AutoCAD-86 shapes 1.0 or 1.1 (its shape 0 the font's name, how far its letters reach above and below the baseline, and its modes; each other shape a letter by its byte) and AutoCAD-86 unifont 1.0 (the font's header first, then each letter by its Unicode number), read as AutoCAD 2021 reads them (check F1a): each letter's advance, the pen's last x, and the points of its ink, from which its box is worked out at any width and slant. txt.shx reaches 6 above and 2 below, its A is inked from 0 to 4 and moves the pen 6.
member.remarks:
The codes of a shape are those ezdxf's shapefile.py and AutoCAD's documentation give: a byte of 0x10 and over a move of its high half's length along one of 16 directions; 0 the end, 1 the pen down, 2 up, 3 and 4 the scale divided or multiplied by the next byte, 5 and 6 the pen's place pushed and popped, 7 a shape drawn within, 8 and 9 moves by signed bytes, 10 an arc of octants, 11 an arc of fractions of them, 12 and 13 arcs by their bulge and 14 the next code for vertical text alone. Read as AutoCAD draws them, where ezdxf reads them otherwise: the number of a shape within a unifont is big-endian; the pen put down marks the point it stands on, a move or not, as fonts end a letter by 8 dx dy 1 2 to mark its right side; the angles of an arc of fractions are whole degrees; and the octants of an arc are of a sign and a size, 0xA4 clockwise from octant 2 for 4. An arc is inked as AutoCAD boxes it, not as it runs: one under half a turn as its chord and the chord moved by its height, half a turn as that half circle's box, and one over half a turn as its whole circle's box. A file of another form, or one cut short, is no font.
A big font, of the form AutoCAD-86 bigfont 1.0 (check F3), holds the letters of two bytes a text style draws beside its font: the ranges of the bytes that open a letter of two, then an index of each letter's number, length and place in the file, its empty places passed over, shape 0 the font's name, height above and depth below its baseline and modes, of five bytes in an extended big font, whose fourth is the width of its cell. Read as AutoCAD 2021 draws it: a height above of nought is 8, as gbcbig.shx's is; a shape within one of two bytes (7 0 hi lo); in an extended big font a shape within of two bytes drawn at a base point from the pen into a box of a width and height given, its cell stretched to the box, the pen put back across after it (7 0 hi lo x y width height); and a whole circle (an arc of octants of a count of nought) not drawn. A letter that draws a shape the font has not, or an arc in a shape it stretches, is not drawn whole.

member.name: T:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfSpace
member.summary: The entities of a space of a , model space, in the order of the file: read as a list, added to and removed from.

remarks.para: writes a shape as a new entity at the end of the ENTITIES section, with a handle of its own above every handle of the file and the model space as its owner, as AutoCAD writes one: a of radius 5 on the layer holes is a CIRCLE on holes. takes an entity out with every record of it, a POLYLINE with its vertices and its end, an INSERT with its attributes and theirs, and its handle is not given again.
The list is not to be changed while it is walked: an enumerator walking it when an entity is added or removed throws on its next step, as a 's does.

The handles of its records are not given to an entity added after, and what pointed at them is seen to when the file is saved: a GROUP no longer lists the entity, a list of reactors no longer holds it, nor a SORTENTSTABLE, and an object it owned, such as its extension dictionary or the reactor of an IMAGE, is removed with it; any other record that points at it keeps the pointer, and the log says which, in one line.

member.name: T:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfSplineOffset
member.summary: The curve at a distance from a spline in the plane of a normal, as gives it: the spline cut at its corners (knots standing as many times as its degree where its direction turns), each smooth piece offset by a cubic fitted to the true offset span by span, and the pieces joined as a polyline's offsets join them, run on to where they meet past a corner they part at, cut back to where they cross at one they overlap at.
member.remarks: A piece is fitted through points of the true offset, each the spline's point moved the distance square to its direction there, four to a span at first; a span is given twice as many points, up to 512, until the fit keeps within the point tolerance of the true offset both ways, halfway between each two points: the true offset's point there from the fit, and the fit's point there from the true offset. A span that does not meet it at 512 is left as it is.

member.name: T:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfStackShape
member.summary:
A stack of an MTEXT (\S1/2;) laid out as AutoCAD 2021 explodes it (probed in its console: Database.DxfOut at R12 of MTEXTs and dimensions, 70 of them): the TEXT of the numerator, a LINE where the stack has a bar (/) or a slash (#), and the TEXT of the denominator, each as high as the letters of the stack. For letters 0.18 high, from the pen's start and the baseline of the denominator, which is the baseline of the line:
1/2: the numerator's baseline 0.24 up (a height and a third of it), the bar 0.21 up (a height and a sixth), the bar as wide as the wider of the two halves (the width of its ink, 0.12 for a 2), each half centred on it. A half with no words stands no height of its own: / alone is a numerator and a denominator of no words 0.06 apart.
^ (a tolerance, +0.1^-0.1): the same, with no bar and both halves held at the left.
#: the numerator at the left and as high as the denominator is high, the denominator after the numerator's pen, a LINE at 55 degrees twice the height long through the numerator's height and 0.03 before the denominator.
No sign (\S12;): the numerator over an empty denominator, as 1/2 with no bar.
The stack moves the pen by its width and a third of its height, and is as high as : 0.42 for a bar (a height, a third of it, and a height).

member.summary: The sign between the halves: /, #, ^, or nought for none.

A line of a TrueType font is boxed by , its ink from the start of its baseline to its last pen. A line drawn beside a big font takes in too, where it ends in a space, where the pen stood in its letters of the big font, so that gbcbig.shx's "中 " 4 high reaches 0.221 below the baseline, not its ink's 0.176; and where it has no ink and ends in no space it is boxed at the start of its baseline, as AutoCAD 2021 boxes a lone ideographic space (check F3).

member.summary: The width of an MTEXT of this one line, as AutoCAD 2021's ActualWidth: from the first ink, or the start of the line where it starts with a space, to the ink of its last letter that is no space, its spaces after it left out; a line of spaces alone as wide as they move the pen. romans "A" is 3.048 wide at 4 high, not its advance of 3.238, and txt " ABC" 22.667. Of a TrueType font, ink left of the start of the line is not counted (check F1a): Arial "A" 4 high is 3.735 wide, from 0 to its ink's right; nor of a line drawn beside a big font (check F3): whgdtxt.shx's "한국어" 4 high 14.083 wide, though inked from -0.208.

A line drawn under or over letters is taken in: txt "\LABC" 4 high is 4.8 high.

member.summary: A TrueType font, of a .ttf or .otf file of glyf outlines or the first face of a .ttc, read as AutoCAD 2021 measures it (checks F1a and F2): its height the top of its letter A, its depth below the baseline its usWinDescent, each letter's advance that of its hmtx and its ink the box its glyf header gives, as AutoCAD boxes it (), no pair of letters kerned. Arial's A reaches 1466 units up and is inked from -3 to 1369, so that "A" 4 high is inked from -0.008 to 3.735, though Arial's capitals are written as 1467 high and its em is 2048.
member.remarks: The tables read are the offset table (of TrueType outlines, 0x00010000 or true, or a collection, ttcf, of which the first face is taken), head (the form of loca), hhea (how many advances hmtx holds), maxp (how many letters), hmtx, cmap (of Windows: the subtable of format 12 of every Unicode number, else that of format 4 of the first 65 536, else the symbols' of format 4, a letter's byte read at U+F000 on), loca and glyf (the header of each letter alone: a letter made of others is boxed by its own), OS/2 (its usWinDescent), and name and head for the face's typeface and whether it is bold or italic. Every read is bounded by the file and its tables: a file of another form, of CFF outlines (OTTO), cut short or of no A of ink is no font, and nothing throws.
member.summary: The outlines of the letters of a TrueType font, read from its glyf table for the commands that turn words into lines (TXTEXP): each letter as closed contours of straight pieces, in the font's units, the curves of the outline (quadratic Béziers, whose off-curve points the font leaves between on-curve ones) cut into six pieces each.

member.name: T:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfVersionConverter
member.summary: Turns the text of a DXF file into the text of the same drawing in another version, as AutoCAD 2021's SaveAs to that version does: the header variables, the groups of each record and the records themselves limited to what the version holds, and what a newer version added left out or given its older form.

remarks.para: AutoCAD keeps every kind of entity and object it has when it saves an older version (a drawing with 15 multileaders, 2 tables and 2 meshes saved as R2000 has 15, 2 and 2), and trims what each writes to what the version holds; so does this: a group a subclass of the version has not is taken out (), a pointer to a record taken out with it, and the dictionary left empty by it.

What the version holds in another form is given that form, as AutoCAD 2021 does: the ACIS body of a solid, binary in the data store from R2013 and text in the entity before it, is turned into the other (Solids, and Regions for a region of flat faces, which is written again); the cells of a table of plain text, written in two forms on either side of R2007, from one to the other (TableDown, TableUp; a number, a general value and a field are words and a handle in the older form); the visual styles of R2007, R2010 and R2013, each in a form of its own (VisualStyle, with the round trip AutoCAD keeps of what the older form has no place for); and the columns of an MTEXT, in its extended data to R2013 and in an embedded object from R2018 (Columns, ColumnsUp). What cannot be given its form is left out or replaced, and said: a table whose cells hold more than words, numbers, a general value and fields (a link to data, a date) becomes the block it is drawn with, and a body whose records the converter does not place (the splines of the ACIS 4.00 text of R2000, a solid made by a sweep) is kept as it is between the versions that hold text, and left out going to R2013 or later (AutoCAD reads a file whose entity holds text there as no drawing) and, its data being binary, going from R2013 to R2010 or before.
R12 (AC1009) is written by rules of its own (DxfVersionConverter.R12.cs and ): what R12 lacks is first broken into what it holds, then the records are given the groups, tables and names R12 has.

member.summary: The conversion to R12 (AC1009), as AutoCAD 2021 writes one drawing as R12: four sections only; the header variables R12 has; the tables of R12 in its order, with no handles and no block records, names in capitals; blocks without handles but their end's, the spaces as $MODEL_SPACE and $PAPER_SPACE; the entities with the groups R12 has, no subclass markers, owners or reactors; and what R12 lacks broken into what it holds ().

The extended data AutoCAD 2021 gives the INSERT a hatch is broken into when it saves R12: the hatch as the application ACAD holds it for R14, which the pieces alone would lose. A hatch of a pattern is HATCH with its name, scale and angle, the objects it follows (ASC_BOUNDS) and its seed points (ASC_SEEDPOINT) when it is associative, then R14_HATCH_DATA; a hatch filled solid or with a gradient holds R14_HATCH_DATA alone.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfVersionConverter.Solids
member.summary: Gives the ACIS data of each body (a 3DSOLID, a BODY, a surface, and a region the library does not read) the form of the target version, by turning the records of one form into the other and not by building the geometry again: the SAB of the data store (R2013 and later) into the SAT of the entity (R2000 to R2010), the SAT into the SAB, and the SAT of one version of the modeler into that of another. A solid of 12 faces comes out as AutoCAD 2021 writes it in the version, record for record: the head's version and flags, a vertex's number from R2007, a coedge's in the binary form; R2000 holds ACIS 4.00, which has no asmheader, no history and no edge parameters (going up they are worked out from the vertices and the curve). A body whose records the grammars do not place (a tolerant edge, the splines of R2000) is left as it is going to R2010 and before, its binary left out there (Plan), and left out going to R2013 and later, which reject a file whose entity holds text.

member.summary: The handle after the highest of the records the file keeps (tables, blocks, entities and objects), as hexadecimal; the seed of the drawing ($HANDSEED) moves past it where it is not past it already, so that a seed that lags behind (a file of another maker's) does not hand it out twice.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfVersionConverter.TableName(GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfVersionConverter.Record)

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfVersionConverter.Letters
member.summary: Puts the letters of a drawing of R2004 or before in place of their escapes where it is saved as R2007 or later. A DXF of R2004 and before holds a letter beyond its code page as \U+1EDB and a letter of a multibyte code page as \M+182A0 (the Shift-JIS a); a DXF of R2007 and later holds the letters themselves, and AutoCAD finds a layer's name that still has the escape "Un-normalized" (AUDIT). An escape typed in the text of a drawing of R2007 or later is the text, and is left.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfVersionConverter.TableDown(GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfVersionConverter.Record)
member.summary: Gives a table of R2007 or later the form of R2004 and before, where each cell is the groups 171 to 178 and 145, its text (1) and the groups of its overrides: the cell's value (301 CELL_VALUE to 304 ACVALUE_END) and its 92 of the later form are left out, its 177 is its 91 less the bits the older form has not. A table that holds its TABLECONTENT (the round trip of its extension dictionary, ACAD_ROUNDTRIP_2008_TABLE_ENTITY) keeps it with the values in the form of R2004. A number, a general value and a field are in the cell as the words they show and the field's handle (see ). False, the table left as it is, where a cell holds anything but those, text or a block (a link, a value of another kind): the caller then draws the table as the block it is drawn with.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfVersionConverter.TableUp(GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfVersionConverter.Record)
member.summary: Gives a table of R2004 or before the form of R2007 and later: each cell with its flags (91), the groups of its overrides before its 92, and its value (301 CELL_VALUE, 93, 90, the text in 1, 94, 300, 302 and 304 ACVALUE_END): where the cell has text 93 is 6, 90 is 4 and 91 has the flag of text, where it has none 93 is 7 and 90 is 0, and a block cell has 93 1 and 90 4. A table that holds its TABLECONTENT has the values of it in the new form and loses the part of its round trip that holds the cells of the form before R2007 (ACAD_ROUNDTRIP_PRE2007_TABLE, with its data table); one that holds none loses the extension dictionary of the round trip (ACAD_XREC_ROUNDTRIP). False, the table left as it is, where a cell holds more than text or a block, or an override the new form is not known to flag (a border's).

Gives one cell of the new form its old form, written to : its head with 177 for 91, its text (1, empty where it has none; a block cell has none), then the groups it holds before its value and after it (the overrides, the block and its attributes). A number (a whole number or a real) or a general value is written as the text it shows (the 302 of its value: 12, 2.500000, nothing), a field (344) as its handle where the words would stand. False where the cell is not made of these: a 92 of a link, a value that is none of those, or groups after the value of the last cell, which may be the table's own.

member.name: M:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfVersionConverter.Masks(System.Collections.Generic.List{GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfVersionConverter.CellData},System.Int32,System.Int32,GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfVersionConverter.RowDefaults)
member.summary: The mask of what each cell sets itself that AutoCAD keeps in its data table: its alignment (0x01), its background colour with the fill (0x06), and each side that has a border of its own (the top 0x4440, right 0x8880, bottom 0x11100, left 0x22200), with the opposite side on the cell across the edge. The content colour, text style and text height are in no mask. A cell that holds only what the table gives it is set nothing: a value that the table's own overrides give every cell, or that the style gives the row across the edge where two kinds of row meet (a lineweight under the title that is also the lineweight over the header), is in the cell's flags and groups as one it set, and AutoCAD's masks of such cells are 0 (ttable, tstyles, tclean; see ). AutoCAD keeps the mask of a cell by what was set on it one property at a time (a lineweight alone sets 0x400 on a top border, a colour 0x40), which the file does not tell from a border set whole; the whole side is taken, as the cell's flags show it.

member.name: T:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfArc
member.summary: An ARC of a DXF file, as AutoCAD's Arc: the part of the circle of about that runs counter-clockwise, seen from the tip of its , from to .

remarks.para: The angles are in radians, as AutoCAD's .NET API gives them, from the x axis of the system the normal makes by the arbitrary axis algorithm of the DXF reference, from nought up to 2 pi; the file holds them in degrees (groups 50 and 51), and an angle set is written in degrees from nought up to 360. The arc of radius 10 about (0, 0, 0) from 0 to pi / 2 runs from (10, 0, 0) to (0, 10, 0): pi / 2, 15.708. An end angle at or below the start runs on past 2 pi: from 3 pi / 2 to pi / 2 is half a turn through 0.

Its parameter is the angle, as AutoCAD's is: is the start angle and the end angle, 2 pi more where it is not above the start. The centre is in world coordinates and the file holds it in the system of the normal, as for a ; every other group of the record is kept as it was.

Set false, the MTEXT taken out, the text keeping its first line, as an attribute of one line (71 of 1). member.summary: Gets the dynamic properties of the INSERT, as AutoCAD's DynamicBlockReferencePropertyCollection: a new list on each call, each property's value the one AutoCAD saved for this INSERT, or the dynamic block's own where it saved none, as for an INSERT of the dynamic block itself. Empty where the INSERT places no dynamic block. The value of a linear, XY, polar, point, rotation, flip, visibility, lookup, user parameter or block properties table property is set as AutoCAD sets it, where the block is one the library works out (); the others are read only.

remarks.para: Each parameter of the block's evaluation graph (ACAD_EVALUATION_GRAPH under ACAD_ENHANCEDBLOCK of its BLOCK_RECORD's extension dictionary) gives its properties, in the order of the graph's nodes; the value saved is the XRECORD named by the parameter's node id under AcDbBlockRepresentation, AppDataCache and ACAD_ENHANCEDBLOCKDATA of the INSERT's extension dictionary. A linear parameter gives its distance; a polar one its distance and its angle; an XY one its distances along x and along y; a rotation one its angle from its base angle, in radians from nought up to a whole turn; a point one its position's x and y; a flip one its state, 0 or 1; a visibility one its state, the first of its states where none is saved; a lookup one the value its table gives. A length is scaled by the largest of the INSERT's scale factors, so that the door of Width 1 000 inserted at a scale of 2 gives 2 000, and a distance of 7.5 along x at the scale (2, 3, 2) 22.5, as AutoCAD 2021 read it. A value set's list is given where its flags hold 8, a list, as AutoCAD gave none of a list under the flags 1, 2 or 4, with the block's own value where the list was written without it, and a value set is taken to that list (plugin D26b). A linear, XY, polar, rotation or constraint parameter also gives, after its own properties, a hidden property Origin, its base point in the block's coordinates (a , type 12, false, read and not set), as AutoCAD 2021 reads it (plugin GhDy3a); a loop that lists the properties as its palette does skips those that are not shown. Actions, grips, base point and alignment parameters give none.

A block properties table gives the property of its name, Block Table1 as AutoCAD names it, a : the index of the first row whose every parameter's column holds the value the INSERT shows, in the block's units, a distance or an angle within 1E-7, as AutoCAD 2021 read 200.00000001 as 200 and 200.0000002 as not (plugin D26b), a text alike, the visibility state among them; -1 where no row does; a column of an attribute definition is not matched; nothing allowed. AutoCAD 2021 read so the library's tables and its own samples (plugin D26): Fluorescent at 1 000 by 500 the row 4, Parking -1 for its Spaces of 1 that no row holds. The table is read after the properties of its columns, in its place in the graph's order. A user parameter the table made gives its value, a (type 5) or a of no units (type 1), named as its variable; a horizontal, a vertical, an aligned or a radial constraint parameter its distance, which is set, but for an aligned one, by solving the block's constraints, as says.

Nothing is worked out anew when the values are read: they are those saved when the block was last evaluated, by AutoCAD or by a value set here, and a block whose geometry was changed by another program keeps the values saved. A record of saved data too short to be read gives the block's own value.

member.returns: The grips, each where the INSERT places it: of a linear or a polar parameter the grip at its end, of an XY parameter the grip at its end and then those at its two other corners (base x with end y, end x with base y), of a rotation parameter the grip at its end, of a flip parameter its grip, of a point, a visibility or a lookup parameter and of a block properties table its grip, where the parameter lists such a grip and gives a property that is not read only. The base grip of a linear or an XY parameter is given, after the end grip, where an action follows its base point (a stretch or a move of BaseXDelta and BaseYDelta, an array), a linear parameter's once the INSERT has saved its values, as AutoCAD 2021 showed it (plugin GhDy2a): its is the base point, and moves it. A polar parameter's base grip is not given, nor is any where no action follows the base point, as a value set moves the end alone; AutoCAD 2021 showed none of an XY parameter then (plugin GhDb1).

remarks.para: A grip stands where the block puts it (the position of its grip object of the block's graph), moved as the point it follows moved from the block's own to where the INSERT saved it (as AutoCAD saved it, or a value set here): the end point of a parameter of two points, the base point of a flip parameter, the position of a point, a visibility or a lookup parameter. A flip's grip flipped is mirrored about the reflection line and points the other way.

The door of AutoCAD 2021's Door - Metric sample at (0, 0) gives Door Size at (750, 0), Wall Thickness at (0, -100), Hinge at (375, -312.5), Swing at (375, -150) and Opening Angle at (-125, 375), as AutoCAD gave them (plugin GhDyn1); a rectangle of a Width from (0, 0) to (100, 0) set to 200 on an INSERT at (1 000, 500) gives Width at (1 200, 500), its base point (1 000, 500) and its direction (1, 0). A rectangle 100 by 50 of an XY parameter from (0, 0) to (100, 50) inserted at (1 000, 500) gives its grips at (1 100, 550), (1 000, 550) and (1 100, 500), as AutoCAD 2021 gave them (plugin GhDb1).

remarks.para: An entity whose class can be moved by the block's placing is a copy of it moved so, as gives it. One the placing cannot keep its class under, as a circle scaled unlike along its two axes, is made of the shapes places of it alone, written as writes them, an ELLIPSE for that circle, with its look; nothing nested is placed for it. An INSERT in the block that cannot hold the placing, one turned in its block under a scale unlike along the world's axes, is exploded in its turn and its parts placed, so that what is drawn stays where it was. A type the library neither moves nor reads, as a REGION or an OLE2FRAME, is left out, and so are a MULTILEADER and an ACAD_TABLE under a placing that scales them unlike along their axes or shears them, which they do not hold.
The entities are made in a drawing of R2018: an ELLIPSE or a SPLINE that a circle or an arc comes out as under a scale unlike along its axes is refused by in a drawing of R12, which has no such type.

What exploding makes is counted before any INSERT of the block is exploded in its turn, and held to the bound the reader holds the INSERTs it places to, 's 2 000 000: each entity given, and each INSERT moved or exploded on the way through the nest; past it, nothing is given. A block of 100 INSERTs, each turned by 20 degrees, of a block of 100 INSERTs turned by 10 degrees of a block of 100 lines, inserted stretched to twice its width, comes out as 1 000 000 lines, its INSERTs exploded all the way down; the same with 200 lines in the last block is refused. member.summary: Clips the block the reference places to a boundary, as AutoCAD's XCLIP New boundary does: the part of the block outside the boundary is no longer shown, and the part inside is. A SPATIAL_FILTER is written into the dictionary ACAD_FILTER of the reference's extension dictionary, each made as AutoCAD makes it, with the boundary as given, the matrix that carries the world into the clip coordinate system, and the inverse of the reference's placing as it stands now. A clip the reference has is replaced. The clip is on, with no clipping planes.
member.param: The points of the boundary in the clip coordinate system: two for a rectangle, its opposite corners, three or more for a polygon, the last not repeating the first.

The transformation that carries a point of the world into the clip coordinate system, which is the user coordinate system current when a boundary is picked; the identity for the world's. It stands for a rotation and a shift, and the third row of its matrix, the clip system's Z axis, is written as the filter's normal.
member.exception: Thrown when the boundary or the transformation is null.
Thrown when the boundary has fewer than two points or a coordinate that is not a finite number, or the transformation flattens space.
Thrown when the reference is in no file, is erased, or is of a file of R12, which has no extension dictionaries.

member.summary: Writes the scale factors and angle of an INSERT that MIRROR has mirrored in the drawing's plane, as AutoCAD 2021's MIRROR writes them (probed in its console, mirror-insert GHMI1 and mirror-3 GHM3B), the block placed as before: its x factor turned the other way, its y and z as they were, and its angle that of its mirrored y axis less a quarter turn, from nought to a whole turn; each factor of 1 and an angle of nought left out. Its ATTRIBs are left where they are. A MINSERT's columns are spaced the other way, its rows as they were: 3 columns 15 apart and 2 rows 8 apart mirrored across a level line are written 41 of -1, 50 of 180, 44 of -15 and 45 of 8. An annotative one's record and each of its contexts are written alike, each from its own factors and angle: the context of 1:2 scaled by 2 and turned nought, mirrored across a level line, is written 41 of -2 and 50 of 180.

member.name: T:GeometryHelper.Dxf.DxfCircle
member.summary: A CIRCLE of a DXF file, as AutoCAD's Circle: the circle of about , in the plane square to its , with the it stands up along the normal.

remarks.para: The circle of radius 5 about (10, 20, 0) is 10, 31.416 and 78.540. Its parameter is the angle in radians, as AutoCAD's is: from nought at the point on the x axis of the normal's own system, (15, 20, 0) here, counter-clockwise seen from the tip of the normal to 2 pi back at that point.

The file holds the centre in the system the normal makes by the arbitrary axis algorithm of the DXF reference; the centre here is in world coordinates, as AutoCAD gives it, and is written back into that system. A circle of a file whose normal is (0, 0, -1) and whose groups 10, 20 and 30 are (10, 20, 5) has its centre at (-10, 20, -5). Setting the normal keeps the centre where it is in the world. Every other group of the record is kept as it was; new DxfCircle(center, normal, radius) { Layer = "steel" } makes one in code, to be added to a drawing by .

member.summary: Gets the curve projected onto a plane along a direction, as AutoCAD's GetProjectedCurve: a new curve of the same look in no file, each point of it moved along the direction until it meets the plane. A line, ray, xline, 3D polyline and spline stay of their kind, their points projected (a spline's fit data taken out, as the projected control points are its curve exactly); an arc, circle or ellipse in a plane parallel to the plane stays of its kind, moved, and otherwise becomes the part of the ellipse it projects to (a circle of radius 10 on the floor projected along (0, 0, 1) onto the plane y + z = 0 is an ellipse of radii 14.14 and 10); a polyline of the plane stays one where its plane is parallel or it has no arc, its vertices taken into the new plane, and otherwise becomes the of its projected , its arcs being parts of ellipses there. A curve that projects to a point, its length there within the point tolerance (a 3D polyline standing along the direction), is refused, and so is a conic seen edge on, or so nearly that its minor axis is within the point tolerance or 1E-6 of its major one, AutoCAD's least ratio of an ellipse's axes: it projects to a line.
